## General introduction

Cystic fibrosis (CF) is a genetic disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the CFTR (Cystic Fibrosis Transmembrane Conductance Regulator) gene. CFTR dysfunction leads to impaired ion transport and the production of thick mucus, primarily affecting the lungs and gastrointestinal tract. People with CF (pwCF) commonly develop chronic airway infections and gastrointestinal complications.

In recent years, CFTR modulator therapies—particularly the triple combination elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor (ETI)—have markedly improved clinical outcomes, especially respiratory function and nutritional status.

In this script, we analyze clinical variables from 9 children and adolescents with CF (7–17 years) assessed before treatment (T0) and after 12 months of ETI (T12).

*Main question:*

-   *Have clinical variables changed after one year of ETI treatment?*

```{r Statistics, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
fmt_n_pct <- function(x, n_total) {
  n <- sum(!is.na(x))
  if (n == 0) return(NA_character_)
  tb <- table(x, useNA = "no")
  out <- paste0(names(tb), ": ", as.integer(tb), " (", round(100*as.integer(tb)/n_total, 1), "%)")
  paste(out, collapse = "; ")
}

fmt_mean_sd <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean(x), stats::sd(x))
}

fmt_median_iqr <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  q <- stats::quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
  sprintf("%.1f [%.1f–%.1f]", q[2], q[1], q[3])
}

  shapiro_p_age <- NA_real_

}

cat("\n=== Normality test (Age, T0) ===\n")

if (!is.null(shapiro_age)) {

  } else {
    cat("Age distribution: Not normal (p =", round(shapiro_p_age, 4), ")\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Not enough values for Shapiro test (n < 3)\n")
}
```

### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results lung function, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_lung <- function(df,
                                  id_col   = "PatientID",
                                  time_col = "Time",
                                  value_col = "ppFEV1",
                                  levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
    " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "paired_t",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = tt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
        T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
      ),
      mean_diff = mean_diff,
      ci = tt$conf.int,
      effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)
    ))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "wilcoxon_paired",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = wt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
        T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
      ),
      median_diff = med_diff,
      effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)
    ))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
auto_paired_test_lung_safe <- function(df,
                                       id_col   = "PatientID",
                                       time_col = "Time",
                                       value_col = "ppFEV1",
                                       levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  tryCatch(
    auto_paired_test_lung(df,
                          id_col = id_col,
                          time_col = time_col,
                          value_col = value_col,
                          levels = levels),
    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("Very few valid pairs", e$message) || grepl("n < 3", e$message)) {
        list(
          variable = value_col,
          method   = "too_few_pairs",
          n        = NA_integer_,
          shapiro  = list(p.value = NA_real_),
          test     = list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_),
          effect_size = list(type = NA_character_, value = NA_real_)
        )
      } else {
        stop(e)
      }
    }
  )
}
```

### Function for plot
```{r Function plots, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
make_paired_plot <- function(df, value_var, res_obj, y_lab, outfile) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_var) %in% names(df)))
  
  d <- df %>%
    mutate(Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0","T12"))) %>%
    group_by(PatientID) %>% filter(n_distinct(Time) == 2) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(x = as.numeric(Time))
  
  col_box   <- c("T0" = "#C0975D", "T12" = "#5D86C0")
  col_point <- c("T0" = "#E0CBAE", "T12" = "#AEC2E0")
  
  d <- d %>%
    mutate(
      fill_box   = col_box[Time],
      fill_point = col_point[Time]
    )
  
  p_val   <- res_obj$test$p.value
  p_label <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3)))
  
  y_max    <- max(d[[value_var]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  p_values <- data.frame(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_max, label = p_label)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    stat_slab(
      data = d %>% filter(Time == "T0"),
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_box),
      side = "left", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    stat_slab(
      data = d %>% filter(Time == "T12"),
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_box),
      side = "right", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_box),
      width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA,
      color = "black", alpha = 0.9, show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_point),
      shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.3, color = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], group = PatientID),
      color = "grey40", alpha = 0.4, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = p_values,
      aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y),
      color = "black", linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = p_values,
      aes(x = (x + xend) / 2, y = y * 1.02, label = label),
      size = 4
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("T0", "T12")) +
    scale_fill_identity(guide = "legend", name = "Time",
                        breaks = col_box, labels = names(col_box)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14))
  
  if (!dir.exists(here("results"))) dir.create(here("results"))
  ggsave(here("results", outfile), p, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  
  invisible(p)
}
```

### Save stats results
```{r Save stats results lung function, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Export: lung function (ppFEV1, ppFVC, FEV1/FVC) ===

.build_row_lung <- function(df, value_col, res_obj, fisher_tab = NULL, cutoff = NA_real_, p_fdr = NA_real_,
                            high_lbl = NULL, low_lbl = NULL) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_col) %in% names(df)))
  is_t <- identical(res_obj$method, "paired_t")

  paired <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12))

  mean_T0  <- mean(paired$T0);  sd_T0  <- sd(paired$T0)
  mean_T12 <- mean(paired$T12); sd_T12 <- sd(paired$T12)

  med_T0 <- median(paired$T0)
  q1_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.25))
  q3_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.75))

  med_T12 <- median(paired$T12)
  q1_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.25))
  q3_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.75))

  fmt_group_T0  <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T0, sd_T0)  else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T0,  q1_T0,  q3_T0)
  fmt_group_T12 <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T12, sd_T12) else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T12, q1_T12, q3_T12)

  
  if (!is.null(fisher_tab)) {
    fisher_res <- fisher.test(fisher_tab, conf.int = TRUE)

    tab_ha <- fisher_tab + 0.5
    a <- tab_ha[high_lbl,"T0"];  b <- tab_ha[high_lbl,"T12"]
    c <- tab_ha[low_lbl,"T0"];   d <- tab_ha[low_lbl,"T12"]

    or_ha   <- (a*d) / (b*c)
    se_log  <- sqrt(1/a + 1/b + 1/c + 1/d)
    ci_low  <- exp(log(or_ha) - 1.96 * se_log)
    ci_high <- exp(log(or_ha) + 1.96 * se_log)

    fisher_p      <- as.numeric(fisher_res$p.value)
    fisher_or     <- if (!is.null(fisher_res$estimate)) as.numeric(fisher_res$estimate) else NA_real_
    fisher_ci_low <- if (!is.null(fisher_res$conf.int)) fisher_res$conf.int[1] else NA_real_
    fisher_ci_high<- if (!is.null(fisher_res$conf.int)) fisher_res$conf.int[2] else NA_real_
  } else {
    fisher_p <- fisher_or <- fisher_ci_low <- fisher_ci_high <- NA_real_
    or_ha <- ci_low <- ci_high <- NA_real_
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    variable      = res_obj$variable,
    method        = res_obj$method,
    n_pairs       = res_obj$n,
    shapiro_p     = unname(res_obj$shapiro$p.value),
    stat          = unname(res_obj$test$statistic),
    p_value       = res_obj$test$p.value,
    group_T0      = fmt_group_T0,
    group_T12     = fmt_group_T12,
    mean_T0  = mean_T0,
    sd_T0    = sd_T0,
    median_T0= med_T0,
    q1_T0    = q1_T0,
    q3_T0    = q3_T0,
    min_T0   = min(paired$T0),
    max_T0   = max(paired$T0),
    range_T0 = max(paired$T0) - min(paired$T0),
    mean_T12   = mean_T12,
    sd_T12     = sd_T12,
    median_T12 = med_T12,
    q1_T12     = q1_T12,
    q3_T12     = q3_T12,
    min_T12    = min(paired$T12),
    max_T12    = max(paired$T12),
    range_T12  = max(paired$T12) - min(paired$T12),
    diff_estimate = if (is_t) res_obj$mean_diff else res_obj$median_diff,
    ci_low        = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[1] else NA_real_,
    ci_high       = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[2] else NA_real_,
    effect_type   = res_obj$effect_size$type,
    effect_value  = res_obj$effect_size$value,
    fisher_p      = fisher_p,
    fisher_or     = fisher_or,
    fisher_ci_low = fisher_ci_low,
    fisher_ci_high= fisher_ci_high,
    or_ha         = or_ha,
    or_ha_ci_low  = if (!is.null(fisher_tab)) ci_low else NA_real_,
    or_ha_ci_high = if (!is.null(fisher_tab)) ci_high else NA_real_,
    cutoff_used   = cutoff
  )
}

row_ppFEV1 <- .build_row_lung(
  df_lung, "ppFEV1", res_ppFEV1,
  fisher_tab = NULL,
  cutoff     = NA_real_,
  high_lbl   = "normal-mild_ppFEV1",
  low_lbl    = "moderate-severe_ppFEV1"
)

row_ppFVC  <- .build_row_lung(df_lung, "ppFVC",   res_ppFVC)        
row_ratio  <- .build_row_lung(df_lung, "FEV1_FVC", res_ratio)       

lung_stats <- dplyr::bind_rows(row_ppFEV1, row_ppFVC, row_ratio)

lung_stats$p_fdr <- p.adjust(lung_stats$p_value, method = "BH")

if (!dir.exists(here("results"))) dir.create(here("results"))
readr::write_excel_csv(lung_stats, here("results", "lung_function_stats.csv"))
```

# SWEAT TEST (Conductivity & Chloride by chlorimetry)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Load in the data
```{r Load in data Cl, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_cl <- readr::read_delim(here::here("data", "conductivity_nutri_ped.csv"))
```

### Create final variables (per timepoint, per patient)
```{r Create final variables Cl, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_cl <- df_cl %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    conductivity_final = rowMeans(dplyr::across(c(conductivity1, conductivity2)), na.rm = TRUE),
    chloride_final     = rowMeans(dplyr::across(c(chlorimetry1, chlorimetry2)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    conductivity_final = dplyr::if_else(is.nan(conductivity_final), NA_real_, conductivity_final),
    chloride_final     = dplyr::if_else(is.nan(chloride_final),     NA_real_, chloride_final)
  )

# Conductivity (final) view
df_cl %>%
```

#### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results Cl, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_cl <- function(df,
                                id_col   = "PatientID",
                                time_col = "Time",
                                value_col = "chloride_final",
                                levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt        <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
        " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "paired_t",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = tt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
        T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
      ),
      mean_diff = mean_diff,
      ci = tt$conf.int,
      effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)
    ))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "wilcoxon_paired",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = wt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
        T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
      ),
      median_diff = med_diff,
      effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)
    ))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
auto_paired_test_cl_safe <- function(df,
                                       id_col   = "PatientID",
                                       time_col = "Time",
                                       value_col = "chloride_final",
                                       levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  tryCatch(
    auto_paired_test_cl(df,
                          id_col = id_col,
                          time_col = time_col,
                          value_col = value_col,
                          levels = levels),
    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("Very few valid pairs", e$message) || grepl("n < 3", e$message)) {
        list(
          variable = value_col,
          method   = "too_few_pairs",
          n        = NA_integer_,
          shapiro  = list(p.value = NA_real_),
          test     = list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_),
          effect_size = list(type = NA_character_, value = NA_real_)
        )
      } else {
        stop(e)
      }
    }
  )
}
```

### Save stats results
```{r Save stats results Cl, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Export: conductivity and chloride ===
.build_row_cl <- function(df, value_col, res_obj, p_fdr = NA_real_) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_col) %in% names(df)))
  is_t <- identical(res_obj$method, "paired_t")

  paired <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12))

  mean_T0  <- mean(paired$T0);  sd_T0  <- sd(paired$T0)
  mean_T12 <- mean(paired$T12); sd_T12 <- sd(paired$T12)

  med_T0 <- median(paired$T0)
  q1_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.25))
  q3_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.75))

  med_T12 <- median(paired$T12)
  q1_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.25))
  q3_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.75))

  fmt_group_T0  <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T0, sd_T0)  else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T0,  q1_T0,  q3_T0)
  fmt_group_T12 <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T12, sd_T12) else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T12, q1_T12, q3_T12)

  tibble::tibble(
    variable      = res_obj$variable,
    method        = res_obj$method,
    n_pairs       = res_obj$n,
    shapiro_p     = unname(res_obj$shapiro$p.value),
    stat          = unname(res_obj$test$statistic),
    p_value       = res_obj$test$p.value,
    group_T0      = fmt_group_T0,
    group_T12     = fmt_group_T12,
    mean_T0  = mean_T0,
    sd_T0    = sd_T0,
    median_T0= med_T0,
    q1_T0    = q1_T0,
    q3_T0    = q3_T0,
    min_T0   = min(paired$T0),
    max_T0   = max(paired$T0),
    range_T0 = max(paired$T0) - min(paired$T0),
    mean_T12   = mean_T12,
    sd_T12     = sd_T12,
    median_T12 = med_T12,
    q1_T12     = q1_T12,
    q3_T12     = q3_T12,
    min_T12    = min(paired$T12),
    max_T12    = max(paired$T12),
    range_T12  = max(paired$T12) - min(paired$T12),
    diff_estimate = if (is_t) res_obj$mean_diff else res_obj$median_diff,
    ci_low        = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[1] else NA_real_,
    ci_high       = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[2] else NA_real_,
    effect_type   = res_obj$effect_size$type,
    effect_value  = res_obj$effect_size$value
  )
}

row_chl <- .build_row_cl(df_cl, "chloride_final", res_chl)
row_cond <- .build_row_cl(df_cl, "conductivity_final", res_cond)

cl_stats <- dplyr::bind_rows(row_chl, row_cond)

cl_stats$p_fdr <- p.adjust(cl_stats$p_value, method = "BH")

if (!dir.exists(here("results"))) dir.create(here("results"))
readr::write_excel_csv(cl_stats, here("results", "conductivity_stats.csv"))
```

```{r Save stats results trans, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    median_T12 = med_T12,
    q1_T12     = q1_T12,
    q3_T12     = q3_T12,
    min_T12    = min(paired$T12),
    max_T12    = max(paired$T12),
    range_T12  = max(paired$T12) - min(paired$T12),
    diff_estimate = if (is_t) res_obj$mean_diff else res_obj$median_diff,
    ci_low        = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[1] else NA_real_,
    ci_high       = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[2] else NA_real_,
    effect_type   = res_obj$effect_size$type,
    effect_value  = res_obj$effect_size$value
  )
}

row_ALT <- .build_row_trans(df_trans, "ALT", res_ALT)
row_AST <- .build_row_trans(df_trans, "AST", res_AST)
row_GGT <- .build_row_trans(df_trans, "GGT", res_GGT)

trans_stats <- dplyr::bind_rows(row_ALT, row_AST, row_GGT)

trans_stats$p_fdr <- p.adjust(trans_stats$p_value, method = "BH")

if (!dir.exists(here("results"))) dir.create(here("results"))
readr::write_excel_csv(trans_stats, here("results", "transaminases_stats.csv"))
```

# CALPROTECTIN

### Load in the data
```{r Load in data calpro, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_calpro <- read_delim(here("data", "calprotectin_nutri_ped.csv"))
```

### Filter data by time
```{r Filter data by time calpro, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data_calpro_T0 <- subset(df_calpro, Time == "T0")
data_calpro_T12 <- subset(df_calpro, Time == "T12")
```

### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results calpro, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_calpro <- function(df,
                                    id_col   = "PatientID",
                                    time_col = "Time",
                                    value_col = "Calprotectin",
                                    levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt        <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
        " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(variable = value_col, method = "paired_t",
                   n = n, shapiro = sh, test = tt,
                   group_summary = list(
                     T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
                     T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
                   ),
                   mean_diff = mean_diff, ci = tt$conf.int,
                   effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(variable = value_col, method = "wilcoxon_paired",
                   n = n, shapiro = sh, test = wt,
                   group_summary = list(
                     T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
                     T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
                   ),
                   median_diff = med_diff,
                   effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
auto_paired_test_calpro_safe <- function(df,
                                       id_col   = "PatientID",
                                       time_col = "Time",
                                       value_col = "Calprotectin",
                                       levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  tryCatch(
    auto_paired_test_calpro(df,
                          id_col = id_col,
                          time_col = time_col,
                          value_col = value_col,
                          levels = levels),
    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("Very few valid pairs", e$message) || grepl("n < 3", e$message)) {
        list(
          variable = value_col,
          method   = "too_few_pairs",
          n        = NA_integer_,
          shapiro  = list(p.value = NA_real_),
          test     = list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_),
          effect_size = list(type = NA_character_, value = NA_real_)
        )
      } else {
        stop(e)
      }
    }
  )
}
```

### Perform statistical test
```{r Execute stats function calpro, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
res_calpro <- auto_paired_test_calpro(df_calpro, value_col = "Calprotectin")
```

##### OPTIONAL: Patients who improved
```{r Stats patients who improved calpro, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cutoff_calpro <- 50

df_calpro_grp <- df_calpro %>%
  mutate(calpro_group = ifelse(Calprotectin >= cutoff_calpro, "high_calpro", "low_calpro"))

contingency_counts_calpro <- df_calpro_grp %>%
  count(calpro_group, Time)

print(contingency_counts_calpro)

table_calpro <- contingency_counts_calpro %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("calpro_group") %>%
  as.matrix()

print(table_calpro)

# Fisher’s test
fisher.test(table_calpro, conf.int = TRUE)

# Halsane-Anscombe test to get a finite OR finite:
table_calpro

fisher.test(table_calpro, conf.int = TRUE)

tab_ha <- table_calpro + 0.5

a <- tab_ha["high_calpro","T0"]
b <- tab_ha["high_calpro","T12"]
c <- tab_ha["low_calpro","T0"]
d <- tab_ha["low_calpro","T12"]

or_ha   <- (a*d) / (b*c)
se_log  <- sqrt(1/a + 1/b + 1/c + 1/d)
ci_low  <- exp(log(or_ha) - 1.96 * se_log)
ci_high <- exp(log(or_ha) + 1.96 * se_log)

cat("\n--- Haldane–Anscombe correction (+0.5) ---\n")
cat("Corrected OR =", round(or_ha, 3),
    " | 95% CI [", round(ci_low, 3), ", ", round(ci_high, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
```

```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results elas, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    ))
```

### Function for plot without NA
```{r Function plot, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
make_paired_plot_elas <- function(df, value_var, res_obj, y_lab, outfile) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_var) %in% names(df)))
  
  d <- df %>%
    mutate(Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0","T12"))) %>%
    group_by(PatientID) %>% filter(n_distinct(Time) == 2) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(x = as.numeric(Time)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[value_var]])) %>%          
    dplyr::group_by(PatientID) %>%                         
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() == 2) %>%                     
    dplyr::ungroup()

  col_box   <- c("T0" = "#C0975D", "T12" = "#5D86C0")
  col_point <- c("T0" = "#E0CBAE", "T12" = "#AEC2E0")
  
  d <- d %>%
    mutate(
      fill_box   = col_box[Time],
      fill_point = col_point[Time]
    )
  
  p_val   <- res_obj$test$p.value
  p_label <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3)))
  
  y_max    <- max(d[[value_var]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  p_values <- data.frame(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_max, label = p_label)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    stat_slab(
      data = d %>% filter(Time == "T0"),
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_box),
      side = "left", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    stat_slab(
      data = d %>% filter(Time == "T12"),
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_box),
      side = "right", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_box),
      width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA,
      color = "black", alpha = 0.9, show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_point),
      shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.3, color = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], group = PatientID),
      color = "grey40", alpha = 0.4, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = p_values,
      aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y),
      color = "black", linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = p_values,
      aes(x = (x + xend) / 2, y = y * 1.02, label = label),
      size = 4
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("T0", "T12")) +
    scale_fill_identity(guide = "legend", name = "Time",
                        breaks = col_box, labels = names(col_box)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14))
  
  if (!dir.exists(here("results"))) dir.create(here("results"))
  ggsave(here("results", outfile), p, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  
  invisible(p)
}
```

### Load in the data
```{r Load in data lip, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_lip <- read_delim(here("data", "lipases_nutri_ped.csv"))
```

### Filter data by time
```{r Filter data by time lip, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data_lip_T0 <- subset(df_lip, Time == "T0")
data_lip_T12 <- subset(df_lip, Time == "T12")
```

### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results lip, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_lip <- function(df,
                                    id_col   = "PatientID",
                                    time_col = "Time",
                                    value_col = "UI_L_kg_day",
                                    levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt        <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
        " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(variable = value_col, method = "paired_t",
                   n = n, shapiro = sh, test = tt,
                   group_summary = list(
                     T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
                     T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
                   ),
                   mean_diff = mean_diff, ci = tt$conf.int,
                   effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(variable = value_col, method = "wilcoxon_paired",
                   n = n, shapiro = sh, test = wt,
                   group_summary = list(
                     T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
                     T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
                   ),
                   median_diff = med_diff,
                   effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
auto_paired_test_lip_safe <- function(df,
                                       id_col   = "PatientID",
                                       time_col = "Time",
                                       value_col = "UI_L_kg_day",
                                       levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  tryCatch(
    auto_paired_test_lip(df,
                          id_col = id_col,
                          time_col = time_col,
                          value_col = value_col,
                          levels = levels),
    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("Very few valid pairs", e$message) || grepl("n < 3", e$message)) {
        list(
          variable = value_col,
          method   = "too_few_pairs",
          n        = NA_integer_,
          shapiro  = list(p.value = NA_real_),
          test     = list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_),
          effect_size = list(type = NA_character_, value = NA_real_)
        )
      } else {
        stop(e)
      }
    }
  )
}
```

#### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results Z-scores, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_z <- function(df,
                               id_col   = "PatientID",
                               time_col = "Time",
                               value_col = "SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010",
                               levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt        <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
        " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "paired_t",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = tt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
        T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
      ),
      mean_diff = mean_diff,
      ci = tt$conf.int,
      effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)
    ))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "wilcoxon_paired",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = wt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
        T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
      ),
      median_diff = med_diff,
      effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)
    ))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
auto_paired_test_z_safe <- function(df,
                                       id_col   = "PatientID",
                                       time_col = "Time",
                                       value_col = "SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010",
                                       levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  tryCatch(
    auto_paired_test_z(df,
                          id_col = id_col,
                          time_col = time_col,
                          value_col = value_col,
                          levels = levels),
    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("Very few valid pairs", e$message) || grepl("n < 3", e$message)) {
        list(
          variable = value_col,
          method   = "too_few_pairs",
          n        = NA_integer_,
          shapiro  = list(p.value = NA_real_),
          test     = list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_),
          effect_size = list(type = NA_character_, value = NA_real_)
        )
      } else {
        stop(e)
      }
    }
  )
}
```

### Save stats results
```{r Save stats results z_score, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Export: z-scores (weight, height, BMI) ===

.build_row_z <- function(df, value_col, res_obj, fisher_tab = NULL, cutoff = NA_real_, p_fdr = NA_real_) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_col) %in% names(df)))
  is_t <- identical(res_obj$method, "paired_t")

  paired <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12))

  mean_T0  <- mean(paired$T0);  sd_T0  <- sd(paired$T0)
  mean_T12 <- mean(paired$T12); sd_T12 <- sd(paired$T12)

  med_T0 <- median(paired$T0)
  q1_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.25))
  q3_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.75))

  med_T12 <- median(paired$T12)
  q1_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.25))
  q3_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.75))

  fmt_group_T0  <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T0, sd_T0)  else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T0,  q1_T0,  q3_T0)
  fmt_group_T12 <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T12, sd_T12) else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T12, q1_T12, q3_T12)

  if (!is.null(fisher_tab)) {
    fisher_res <- fisher.test(fisher_tab, conf.int = TRUE)

    tab_ha <- fisher_tab + 0.5

    a <- tab_ha["high_BMIz","T0"];  b <- tab_ha["high_BMIz","T12"]
    c <- tab_ha["low_BMIz","T0"];   d <- tab_ha["low_BMIz","T12"]

    or_ha   <- (a*d) / (b*c)
    se_log  <- sqrt(1/a + 1/b + 1/c + 1/d)
    ci_low  <- exp(log(or_ha) - 1.96 * se_log)
    ci_high <- exp(log(or_ha) + 1.96 * se_log)

    fisher_p      <- as.numeric(fisher_res$p.value)
    fisher_or     <- if (!is.null(fisher_res$estimate)) as.numeric(fisher_res$estimate) else NA_real_
    fisher_ci_low <- if (!is.null(fisher_res$conf.int)) fisher_res$conf.int[1] else NA_real_
    fisher_ci_high<- if (!is.null(fisher_res$conf.int)) fisher_res$conf.int[2] else NA_real_
  } else {
    fisher_p <- fisher_or <- fisher_ci_low <- fisher_ci_high <- NA_real_
    or_ha <- ci_low <- ci_high <- NA_real_
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    variable      = res_obj$variable,
    method        = res_obj$method,
    n_pairs       = res_obj$n,
    shapiro_p     = unname(res_obj$shapiro$p.value),
    stat          = unname(res_obj$test$statistic),
    p_value       = res_obj$test$p.value,
    group_T0      = fmt_group_T0,
    group_T12     = fmt_group_T12,
    mean_T0    = mean_T0,
    sd_T0      = sd_T0,
    median_T0  = med_T0,
    q1_T0      = q1_T0,
    q3_T0      = q3_T0,
    min_T0     = min(paired$T0),
    max_T0     = max(paired$T0),
    range_T0   = max(paired$T0) - min(paired$T0),
    mean_T12   = mean_T12,
    sd_T12     = sd_T12,
    median_T12 = med_T12,
    q1_T12     = q1_T12,
    q3_T12     = q3_T12,
    min_T12    = min(paired$T12),
    max_T12    = max(paired$T12),
    range_T12  = max(paired$T12) - min(paired$T12),
    diff_estimate = if (is_t) res_obj$mean_diff else res_obj$median_diff,
    ci_low        = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[1] else NA_real_,
    ci_high       = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[2] else NA_real_,
    effect_type   = res_obj$effect_size$type,
    effect_value  = res_obj$effect_size$value,
    fisher_p      = fisher_p,
    fisher_or     = fisher_or,
    fisher_ci_low = fisher_ci_low,
    fisher_ci_high= fisher_ci_high,
    or_ha         = or_ha,
    or_ha_ci_low  = if (!is.null(fisher_tab)) ci_low else NA_real_,
    or_ha_ci_high = if (!is.null(fisher_tab)) ci_high else NA_real_,
    cutoff_used   = cutoff
  )
}

row_z_wt  <- .build_row_z(df_z, "SD_z_score_weight_2010",             res_z_wt)
row_z_ht  <- .build_row_z(df_z, "SD_z_score_height_2010",             res_z_ht)
```

```{r Filter data by time bio, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data_bio_T12 <- subset(df_bio, Time == "T12")
```

### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results bio, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_bio <- function(df,
                                   id_col   = "PatientID",
                                   time_col = "Time",
                                   value_col = "fat_mass_perc",
                                   levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt        <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
        " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "paired_t",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = tt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
        T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
      ),
      mean_diff = mean_diff,
      ci = tt$conf.int,
      effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)
    ))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "wilcoxon_paired",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = wt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
        T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
      ),
      median_diff = med_diff,
      effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)
    ))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
auto_paired_test_bio_safe <- function(df,
                                       id_col   = "PatientID",
                                       time_col = "Time",
                                       value_col = "fat_mass_perc",
                                       levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  tryCatch(
    auto_paired_test_bio(df,
                          id_col = id_col,
                          time_col = time_col,
                          value_col = value_col,
                          levels = levels),
    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("Very few valid pairs", e$message) || grepl("n < 3", e$message)) {
        list(
          variable = value_col,
          method   = "too_few_pairs",
          n        = NA_integer_,
          shapiro  = list(p.value = NA_real_),
          test     = list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_),
          effect_size = list(type = NA_character_, value = NA_real_)
        )
      } else {
        stop(e)
      }
    }
  )
}
```

### Save stats results
```{r Save stats results bio, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Export: fat_mass_perc, lean_mass_perc, fat_mass_index_kgm2, phase_angle, body_cell_mass_perc, total_body_water_perc ===
.build_row_bio <- function(df, value_col, res_obj, p_fdr = NA_real_) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_col) %in% names(df)))
  is_t <- identical(res_obj$method, "paired_t")

  paired <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12))

  mean_T0  <- mean(paired$T0);  sd_T0  <- sd(paired$T0)
  mean_T12 <- mean(paired$T12); sd_T12 <- sd(paired$T12)

  med_T0 <- median(paired$T0)
  q1_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.25))
  q3_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.75))

  med_T12 <- median(paired$T12)
  q1_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.25))
  q3_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.75))

  fmt_group_T0  <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T0, sd_T0)  else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T0,  q1_T0,  q3_T0)
  fmt_group_T12 <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T12, sd_T12) else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T12, q1_T12, q3_T12)

  tibble::tibble(
    variable      = res_obj$variable,
    method        = res_obj$method,
    n_pairs       = res_obj$n,
    shapiro_p     = unname(res_obj$shapiro$p.value),
    stat          = unname(res_obj$test$statistic),
    p_value       = res_obj$test$p.value,
    group_T0      = fmt_group_T0,
    group_T12     = fmt_group_T12,
    mean_T0  = mean_T0,
    sd_T0    = sd_T0,
    median_T0= med_T0,
    q1_T0    = q1_T0,
    q3_T0    = q3_T0,
    min_T0   = min(paired$T0),
    max_T0   = max(paired$T0),
    range_T0 = max(paired$T0) - min(paired$T0),
    mean_T12   = mean_T12,
    sd_T12     = sd_T12,
    median_T12 = med_T12,
    q1_T12     = q1_T12,
    q3_T12     = q3_T12,
    min_T12    = min(paired$T12),
    max_T12    = max(paired$T12),
    range_T12  = max(paired$T12) - min(paired$T12),
    diff_estimate = if (is_t) res_obj$mean_diff else res_obj$median_diff,
    ci_low        = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[1] else NA_real_,
    ci_high       = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[2] else NA_real_,
    effect_type   = res_obj$effect_size$type,
    effect_value  = res_obj$effect_size$value
  )
}

row_fatmass <- .build_row_bio(df_bio, "fat_mass_perc", res_fatmass)
row_leanmass <- .build_row_bio(df_bio, "lean_mass_perc", res_leanmass)
row_fatmassindex <- .build_row_bio(df_bio, "fat_mass_index_kgm2", res_fatmassindex)
row_phaseangle <- .build_row_bio(df_bio, "phase_angle", res_phaseangle)
row_bodycellmass <- .build_row_bio(df_bio, "body_cell_mass_perc", res_bodycellmass)
row_totalbodywater <- .build_row_bio(df_bio, "total_body_water_perc", res_totalbodywater)

readr::write_excel_csv(bio_stats, here("results", "bioimpedance_stats.csv"))
```

### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results day, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_day <- function(df,
                                   id_col   = "PatientID",
                                   time_col = "Time",
                                   value_col = "Ingestion_kcalday",
                                   levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt        <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
        " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "paired_t",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = tt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
        T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
      ),
      mean_diff = mean_diff,
      ci = tt$conf.int,
      effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)
    ))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "wilcoxon_paired",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = wt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
        T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
      ),
      median_diff = med_diff,
      effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)
    ))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
auto_paired_test_day_safe <- function(df,
                                       id_col   = "PatientID",
                                       time_col = "Time",
                                       value_col = "Ingestion_kcalday",
                                       levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  tryCatch(
    auto_paired_test_day(df,
                          id_col = id_col,
                          time_col = time_col,
                          value_col = value_col,
                          levels = levels),
    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("Very few valid pairs", e$message) || grepl("n < 3", e$message)) {
        list(
          variable = value_col,
          method   = "too_few_pairs",
          n        = NA_integer_,
          shapiro  = list(p.value = NA_real_),
          test     = list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_),
          effect_size = list(type = NA_character_, value = NA_real_)
        )
      } else {
        stop(e)
      }
    }
  )
}
```

```{r Forest plot day, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Helpers
resolve_vars <- function(df, vars) {
  sapply(vars, function(v) {
    idx <- which(tolower(names(df)) == tolower(v))
    if (length(idx) == 0) stop("I do not find the column: ", v)
    names(df)[idx[1]]
  }) |> unname()
}

ci_dz_from_t <- function(t_obs, n, conf = 0.95) {
  df <- n - 1
  if (!is.finite(t_obs) || n < 2) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  if (requireNamespace("MBESS", quietly = TRUE)) {
    lim <- MBESS::conf.limits.nct(t = t_obs, df = df, conf.level = conf)
    c(lim$Lower.Limit / sqrt(n), lim$Upper.Limit / sqrt(n))
  } else {
    d  <- t_obs / sqrt(n)
    se <- sqrt((1/n) + (d^2 / (2 * df)))
    crit <- qt(1 - (1 - conf)/2, df = df)
    c(d - crit*se, d + crit*se)
  }
}

# Prepare deltas and z_individual (delta/SD(delta))
vars_resolved <- resolve_vars(df_day, var_map$var)

df_long <- df_day %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, dplyr::all_of(vars_resolved)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(vars_resolved),
    names_to = "var_resolved",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0", "T12")))

df_wide <- df_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = value) %>%
  filter(!is.na(T0) & !is.na(T12)) %>%
  mutate(diff = T12 - T0)

map_df <- tibble(var_resolved = vars_resolved) %>% bind_cols(var_map)

df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  left_join(map_df, by = "var_resolved")

# SD of delta per variable + z individual
ind_df <- df_wide %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_diff = sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    z_ind   = ifelse(sd_diff > 0, diff / sd_diff, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rev(var_map$label)))


sum_df <- ind_df %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(z_ind)),
    dz = mean(z_ind, na.rm = TRUE),
    t_obs = ifelse(n > 1, dz * sqrt(n), NA_real_),  # t = dz*sqrt(n)
    dz_low  = ci_dz_from_t(t_obs, n)[1],
    dz_high = ci_dz_from_t(t_obs, n)[2],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = ifelse(dz >= 0, "Increase (T12 > T0)", "Decrease (T12 < T0)"),
    label = factor(label, levels = levels(ind_df$label))
  )

# Forest plot
col_change <- c(
  "Decrease (T12 < T0)" = "#C0975D",
  "Increase (T12 > T0)" = "#5D86C0"
)

stripe_df <- ind_df %>%
  distinct(label) %>%
  mutate(y = as.numeric(label), stripe = y %% 2 == 0)

x_min <- min(c(ind_df$z_ind, sum_df$dz_low), na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(c(ind_df$z_ind, sum_df$dz_high), na.rm = TRUE)
x_pad <- 0.12 * (x_max - x_min)

p_forest_box_nopoints <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(
    data = stripe_df %>% filter(stripe),
    aes(ymin = y - 0.5, ymax = y + 0.5),
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
    inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.06
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(
  data = ind_df %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(
      sum_df %>% dplyr::select(label, direction), 
      by = "label"),
  aes(x = z_ind, y = label, fill = direction),
  width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    data = sum_df,
    aes(y = label, xmin = dz_low, xmax = dz_high),
    height = 0.12, linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = sum_df,
    aes(y = label, x = dz, fill = direction),
    shape = 21, size = 2.6, stroke = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_change) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(x_min - x_pad, x_max + x_pad), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Standardized change (Cohen's dz; T12 − T0)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "plain")
  )
```

### Save stats results
```{r Save stats results day, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Export 3-day dietary record variables ===
.build_row_day <- function(df, value_col, res_obj, p_fdr = NA_real_) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_col) %in% names(df)))
  is_t <- identical(res_obj$method, "paired_t")

  paired <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12))

  mean_T0  <- mean(paired$T0);  sd_T0  <- sd(paired$T0)
  mean_T12 <- mean(paired$T12); sd_T12 <- sd(paired$T12)

  med_T0 <- median(paired$T0)
  q1_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.25))
  q3_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.75))

  med_T12 <- median(paired$T12)
  q1_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.25))
  q3_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.75))

  fmt_group_T0  <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T0, sd_T0)  else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T0,  q1_T0,  q3_T0)
  fmt_group_T12 <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T12, sd_T12) else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T12, q1_T12, q3_T12)

  tibble::tibble(
    variable      = res_obj$variable,
    method        = res_obj$method,
    n_pairs       = res_obj$n,
    shapiro_p     = unname(res_obj$shapiro$p.value),
    stat          = unname(res_obj$test$statistic),
    p_value       = res_obj$test$p.value,
    group_T0      = fmt_group_T0,
    group_T12     = fmt_group_T12,
    mean_T0  = mean_T0,
    sd_T0    = sd_T0,
    median_T0= med_T0,
    q1_T0    = q1_T0,
    q3_T0    = q3_T0,
    min_T0   = min(paired$T0),
    max_T0   = max(paired$T0),
    range_T0 = max(paired$T0) - min(paired$T0),
    mean_T12   = mean_T12,
    sd_T12     = sd_T12,
    median_T12 = med_T12,
    q1_T12     = q1_T12,
    q3_T12     = q3_T12,
    min_T12    = min(paired$T12),
    max_T12    = max(paired$T12),
    range_T12  = max(paired$T12) - min(paired$T12),
    diff_estimate = if (is_t) res_obj$mean_diff else res_obj$median_diff,
    ci_low        = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[1] else NA_real_,
    ci_high       = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[2] else NA_real_,
    effect_type   = res_obj$effect_size$type,
    effect_value  = res_obj$effect_size$value
  )
}
```

### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results schol, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_schol <- function(df,
                                  id_col   = "PatientID",
                                  time_col = "Time",
                                  value_col = "serum_cholesterol_mgdL",
                                  levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt        <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
        " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "paired_t",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = tt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
        T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
      ),
      mean_diff = mean_diff,
      ci = tt$conf.int,
      effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)
    ))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "wilcoxon_paired",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = wt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
        T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
      ),
      median_diff = med_diff,
      effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)
    ))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
auto_paired_test_elas_schol <- function(df,
                                       id_col   = "PatientID",
                                       time_col = "Time",
                                       value_col = "serum_cholesterol_mgdL",
                                       levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  tryCatch(
    auto_paired_test_schol(df,
                          id_col = id_col,
                          time_col = time_col,
                          value_col = value_col,
                          levels = levels),
    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("Very few valid pairs", e$message) || grepl("n < 3", e$message)) {
        list(
          variable = value_col,
          method   = "too_few_pairs",
          n        = NA_integer_,
          shapiro  = list(p.value = NA_real_),
          test     = list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_),
          effect_size = list(type = NA_character_, value = NA_real_)
        )
      } else {
        stop(e)
      }
    }
  )
}
```

### Function for plot without NA
```{r Function plot schol, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
make_paired_plot_schol <- function(df, value_var, res_obj, y_lab, outfile) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_var) %in% names(df)))
  
  d <- df %>%
    mutate(Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0","T12"))) %>%
    group_by(PatientID) %>% filter(n_distinct(Time) == 2) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(x = as.numeric(Time)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[value_var]])) %>%          
    dplyr::group_by(PatientID) %>%                         
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() == 2) %>%                     
    dplyr::ungroup()

  col_box   <- c("T0" = "#C0975D", "T12" = "#5D86C0")
  col_point <- c("T0" = "#E0CBAE", "T12" = "#AEC2E0")
  
  d <- d %>%
    mutate(
      fill_box   = col_box[Time],
      fill_point = col_point[Time]
    )
  
  p_val   <- res_obj$test$p.value
  p_label <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3)))
  
  y_max    <- max(d[[value_var]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  p_values <- data.frame(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_max, label = p_label)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    stat_slab(
      data = d %>% filter(Time == "T0"),
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_box),
      side = "left", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    stat_slab(
      data = d %>% filter(Time == "T12"),
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_box),
      side = "right", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_box),
      width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA,
      color = "black", alpha = 0.9, show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_point),
      shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.3, color = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], group = PatientID),
      color = "grey40", alpha = 0.4, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = p_values,
      aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y),
      color = "black", linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = p_values,
      aes(x = (x + xend) / 2, y = y * 1.02, label = label),
      size = 4
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("T0", "T12")) +
    scale_fill_identity(guide = "legend", name = "Time",
                        breaks = col_box, labels = names(col_box)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14))
  
  if (!dir.exists(here("results"))) dir.create(here("results"))
  ggsave(here("results", outfile), p, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  
  invisible(p)
}
```
