#### Distribution plot
```{r Panel plots schol, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# --- variables to plot (display name = column in df_schol) ---
lipid_cols <- c(
  "Total cholesterol (mg/dL)" = "serum_cholesterol_mgdL",
  "HDL (mg/dL)"               = "serum_HDL_mgdL",
  "LDL (mg/dL)"               = "serum_LDL_mgdL",
  #"LDL/HDL ratio"             = "LDL_HDL_ratio",
  "Triglycerides (mg/dL)"     = "serum_triglycerides_mgdL",
  "Non-HDL (mg/dL)"           = "non_HDL_mgdL"
)

# --- fill colors by timepoint ---
pal_time <- c("T0" = "#E0CBAE", "T12" = "#AEC2E0")

# --- quantile line styling (median / quartiles) ---
col_med <- "#555555"
col_q   <- "#555555"
w_med   <- 0.7
w_q     <- 0.5

 
# --- reshape to long format ---
df_long <- df_schol %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, tidyselect::any_of(unname(lipid_cols))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = tidyselect::any_of(unname(lipid_cols)),
    names_to = "marker_raw",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    marker = names(lipid_cols)[match(marker_raw, unname(lipid_cols))],
    # bottom-to-top order (so triglycerides stays at the bottom)
    marker = factor(marker, levels = c(
      "Non-HDL (mg/dL)",
      "Triglycerides (mg/dL)",
      "LDL (mg/dL)",
      "HDL (mg/dL)",
      "Total cholesterol (mg/dL)"
    )),
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0", "T12"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value))

# --- extra vertical spacing to prevent overlap between lipids ---
y_spacing <- 1.35  # increase (e.g., 1.5) if ridges still overlap; decrease (e.g., 1.2) if too spaced
df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(marker_y = as.numeric(marker) * y_spacing)

df_T0  <- df_long %>% filter(Time == "T0")
df_T12 <- df_long %>% filter(Time == "T12")

# --- shared ridge parameters (keep consistent across layers) ---
ridge_scale  <- 0.95   # lower = shorter ridges = less vertical overlap
ridge_relmin <- 0.01

# --- fixed bandwidth to avoid repeated "Picking joint bandwidth..." messages ---
bw <- stats::bw.nrd0(df_long$value)

# --- breaks/labels for the continuous y-axis (since we use marker_y) ---
marker_levels <- levels(df_long$marker)
y_breaks <- seq_along(marker_levels) * y_spacing
y_labels <- marker_levels

p_lipids <- ggplot(mapping = aes(x = value, y = marker_y)) +

  # =========================
  # 1) T0 layers (drawn first -> stays behind T12)
  # =========================

  # T0 ridge fill
  geom_density_ridges(
    data = df_T0,
    aes(group = marker, fill = Time),
    position = "identity",
    scale = ridge_scale,
    rel_min_height = ridge_relmin,
    bandwidth = bw,
    alpha = 0.70,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  # T0 quartiles (Q1 & Q3) - clipped automatically to the ridge height
  geom_density_ridges(
    data = df_T0,
    aes(group = marker),
    position = "identity",
    scale = ridge_scale,
    rel_min_height = ridge_relmin,
    bandwidth = bw,
    alpha = 0, color = NA, linewidth = 0,  # invisible ridge, keep only vlines
    quantile_lines = TRUE,
    quantiles = c(0.25, 0.75),
    vline_color = col_q,
    vline_linetype = "dashed",
    vline_width = w_q
  ) +
  # T0 median - clipped automatically to the ridge height
  geom_density_ridges(
    data = df_T0,
    aes(group = marker),
    position = "identity",
    scale = ridge_scale,
    rel_min_height = ridge_relmin,
    bandwidth = bw,
    alpha = 0, color = NA, linewidth = 0,
    quantile_lines = TRUE,
    quantiles = 0.50,
    vline_color = col_med,
    vline_linetype = "solid",
    vline_width = w_med
  ) +

  # =========================
  # 2) T12 layers (drawn after -> sits on top of T0)
  # =========================

  # T12 ridge fill
  geom_density_ridges(
    data = df_T12,
    aes(group = marker, fill = Time),
    position = "identity",
    scale = ridge_scale,
    rel_min_height = ridge_relmin,
    bandwidth = bw,
    alpha = 0.70,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  # T12 quartiles (Q1 & Q3)
  geom_density_ridges(
    data = df_T12,
    aes(group = marker),
    position = "identity",
    scale = ridge_scale,
    rel_min_height = ridge_relmin,
    bandwidth = bw,
    alpha = 0, color = NA, linewidth = 0,
    quantile_lines = TRUE,
    quantiles = c(0.25, 0.75),
    vline_color = col_q,
    vline_linetype = "dashed",
    vline_width = w_q
  ) +
  # T12 median
  geom_density_ridges(
    data = df_T12,
    aes(group = marker),
    position = "identity",
    scale = ridge_scale,
    rel_min_height = ridge_relmin,
    bandwidth = bw,
    alpha = 0, color = NA, linewidth = 0,
    quantile_lines = TRUE,
    quantiles = 0.50,
    vline_color = col_med,
    vline_linetype = "solid",
    vline_width = w_med
  ) +

  # --- fills and axes ---
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_time, drop = FALSE, name = "Time") +

  # add a small x-margin so the density does not touch the axis limits
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.03))) +

  # use a continuous y-scale (marker_y) with custom labels and extra top/bottom padding
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = y_breaks,
    labels = y_labels,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.04))  # bottom padding separates the x-axis from the lowest ridge
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Serum lipids distribution",
    x = "Serum concentration (mg/dL)",
    y = NULL
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +

  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    # make horizontal grid lines match vertical ones
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.35),

    # remove the outer black frame
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    plot.margin  = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

ggsave(
  here("results", "serum_lipids_distribution_all.svg"),
  p_lipids, width = 6, height = 6, bg = "white"
)
```

### See results absolute and ratios
```{r Results absolute and ratios schol, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1) Keep ONLY patients with paired HDL + LDL at T0 and T12 (n=7)
df_schol_paired <- df_schol %>%
  dplyr::select(
    PatientID, Time,
    serum_HDL_mgdL, serum_LDL_mgdL,
    serum_cholesterol_mgdL, serum_triglycerides_mgdL
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Time,
    values_from = c(
      serum_HDL_mgdL, serum_LDL_mgdL,
      serum_cholesterol_mgdL, serum_triglycerides_mgdL
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    complete.cases(
      serum_HDL_mgdL_T0, serum_HDL_mgdL_T12,
      serum_LDL_mgdL_T0, serum_LDL_mgdL_T12
    )
  )

# 2) Compute absolutes + ratios + non-HDL + deltas (ONLY in paired subset)
tab_lipids_paired7 <- df_schol_paired %>%
  transmute(
    PatientID,

    # Absolutes
    HDL_T0 = serum_HDL_mgdL_T0,
    HDL_T12 = serum_HDL_mgdL_T12,
    d_HDL = HDL_T12 - HDL_T0,

    LDL_T0 = serum_LDL_mgdL_T0,
    LDL_T12 = serum_LDL_mgdL_T12,
    d_LDL = LDL_T12 - LDL_T0,

    # Ratios (computed from paired LDL/HDL)
    LDL_HDL_ratio_T0  = serum_LDL_mgdL_T0  / serum_HDL_mgdL_T0,
    LDL_HDL_ratio_T12 = serum_LDL_mgdL_T12 / serum_HDL_mgdL_T12,
    d_LDL_HDL_ratio   = LDL_HDL_ratio_T12 - LDL_HDL_ratio_T0,

    HDL_LDL_ratio_T0  = serum_HDL_mgdL_T0  / serum_LDL_mgdL_T0,
    HDL_LDL_ratio_T12 = serum_HDL_mgdL_T12 / serum_LDL_mgdL_T12,
    d_HDL_LDL_ratio   = HDL_LDL_ratio_T12 - HDL_LDL_ratio_T0,

    # Non-HDL (only if total cholesterol exists; may be NA if missing)
    non_HDL_T0  = serum_cholesterol_mgdL_T0  - serum_HDL_mgdL_T0,
    non_HDL_T12 = serum_cholesterol_mgdL_T12 - serum_HDL_mgdL_T12,
    d_non_HDL   = non_HDL_T12 - non_HDL_T0,

    # Optional extra serum markers (keep if you want; will be NA if missing)
    TotalChol_T0  = serum_cholesterol_mgdL_T0,
    TotalChol_T12 = serum_cholesterol_mgdL_T12,
    d_TotalChol   = TotalChol_T12 - TotalChol_T0,

    TG_T0  = serum_triglycerides_mgdL_T0,
    TG_T12 = serum_triglycerides_mgdL_T12,
    d_TG   = TG_T12 - TG_T0,

    # Simple interpretation label from LDL/HDL ratio change
    LDL_vs_HDL_dir = case_when(
      is.na(d_LDL_HDL_ratio) ~ NA_character_,
      d_LDL_HDL_ratio > 0 ~ "LDL relatively ↑ vs HDL (ratio ↑)",
      d_LDL_HDL_ratio < 0 ~ "HDL relatively ↑ vs LDL (ratio ↓)",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(parse_number(PatientID))

# 3) Save CSV (paired only)
readr::write_excel_csv(tab_lipids_paired7, here("results", "tab_lipids_paired7_ratios.csv"))
```


### HDL vs LDL
En promedio, dentro de cada paciente, ¿HDL cambia más que LDL?”
porque dDiff > 0 implica que HDL aumentó más (o bajó menos) que LDL, y dDiff < 0 lo contrario.
```{r HDL vs LDL schol, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Build deltas (HDL, LDL) and dDiff = ΔHDL − ΔLDL
delta <- df_schol %>%
  dplyr::select(
    PatientID, Time,
    HDL = serum_HDL_mgdL,
    LDL = serum_LDL_mgdL
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Time,
    values_from = c(HDL, LDL)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    complete.cases(HDL_T0, HDL_T12, LDL_T0, LDL_T12)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dHDL  = HDL_T12 - HDL_T0,
    dLDL  = LDL_T12 - LDL_T0,
    dDiff = dHDL - dLDL
  )

# Test on dDiff (ΔHDL − ΔLDL)
diff <- delta$dDiff
n <- length(diff)
if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")

sh <- shapiro.test(diff)
normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05

cat("\n=== Auto test (dDiff = ΔHDL − ΔLDL) ===\n")
cat("n =", n, "| Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), "\n")

if (normal) {
  tt <- t.test(diff, mu = 0)
  mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_diff   <- sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
  d_es      <- mean_diff / sd_diff

  cat("Normality of differences: Normal\n")
  cat("Chosen test: One-sample t-test on dDiff (mu = 0)\n")
  cat("t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
  cat("Mean dDiff =", round(mean_diff, 3),
      " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
  cat("Effect size (Cohen's d) =", round(d_es, 3), "\n")

  stats_tbl <- data.frame(
    comparison = "dDiff = (ΔHDL) − (ΔLDL)",
    n = n,
    shapiro_p = sh$p.value,
    normal = TRUE,
    test = "one-sample t-test (mu=0)",
    statistic = unname(tt$statistic),
    p_value = tt$p.value,
    estimate = mean_diff,
    sd = sd_diff,
    effect_size = d_es,
    ci_low = tt$conf.int[1],
    ci_high = tt$conf.int[2]
  )

} else {
  wt <- wilcox.test(diff, mu = 0, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
  V <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
  r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
  med <- median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)

  cat("Normality of differences: Not normal\n")
  cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank on dDiff (mu = 0)\n")
  cat("V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
  cat("Median dDiff =", round(med, 3), "\n")
  cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")

  stats_tbl <- data.frame(
    comparison = "dDiff = (ΔHDL) − (ΔLDL)",
    n = n,
    shapiro_p = sh$p.value,
    normal = FALSE,
    test = "Wilcoxon signed-rank (mu=0)",
    statistic = V,
    p_value = wt$p.value,
    estimate = med,
    sd = NA_real_,
    effect_size = r_rb,
    ci_low = NA_real_,
    ci_high = NA_real_
  )
}

# Save stats table to CSV
write.csv(stats_tbl, "HDL_vs_LDL_dDiff_stats.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r BMIz up subgroup in schol, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    method   = res$method,
    n        = res$n %||% NA_integer_,
    p_value  = res$test$p.value %||% NA_real_,
```

### Load in the data
```{r Load in data vits, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_vits <- read_delim(here("data", "vitamins_nutri_ped.csv"))
```

### Filter data by time
```{r Filter data by time vits, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data_vits_T0 <- subset(df_vits, Time == "T0")
data_vits_T12 <- subset(df_vits, Time == "T12")
```

### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results vits, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_vits <- function(df,
                                   id_col   = "PatientID",
                                   time_col = "Time",
                                   value_col = "VitaminA_ugdL",
                                   levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt        <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
        " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "paired_t",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = tt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
        T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
      ),
      mean_diff = mean_diff,
      ci = tt$conf.int,
      effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)
    ))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "wilcoxon_paired",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = wt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
        T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
      ),
      median_diff = med_diff,
      effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)
    ))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
auto_paired_test_vits_safe <- function(df,
                                       id_col   = "PatientID",
                                       time_col = "Time",
                                       value_col = "VitaminA_ugdL",
                                       levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  tryCatch(
    auto_paired_test_vits(df,
                          id_col = id_col,
                          time_col = time_col,
                          value_col = value_col,
                          levels = levels),
    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("Very few valid pairs", e$message) || grepl("n < 3", e$message)) {
        list(
          variable = value_col,
          method   = "too_few_pairs",
          n        = NA_integer_,
          shapiro  = list(p.value = NA_real_),
          test     = list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_),
          effect_size = list(type = NA_character_, value = NA_real_)
        )
      } else {
        stop(e)
      }
    }
  )
}
```

### Save stats results
```{r Save stats results vits, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Export: Serum vitamins ===
.build_row_vits <- function(df, value_col, res_obj, p_fdr = NA_real_) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_col) %in% names(df)))
  is_t <- identical(res_obj$method, "paired_t")

  paired <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12))

  mean_T0  <- mean(paired$T0);  sd_T0  <- sd(paired$T0)
  mean_T12 <- mean(paired$T12); sd_T12 <- sd(paired$T12)

  med_T0 <- median(paired$T0)
  q1_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.25))
  q3_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.75))

  med_T12 <- median(paired$T12)
  q1_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.25))
  q3_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.75))

  fmt_group_T0  <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T0, sd_T0)  else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T0,  q1_T0,  q3_T0)
  fmt_group_T12 <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T12, sd_T12) else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T12, q1_T12, q3_T12)

  tibble::tibble(
    variable      = res_obj$variable,
    method        = res_obj$method,
    n_pairs       = res_obj$n,
    shapiro_p     = unname(res_obj$shapiro$p.value),
    stat          = unname(res_obj$test$statistic),
    p_value       = res_obj$test$p.value,
    group_T0      = fmt_group_T0,
    group_T12     = fmt_group_T12,
    mean_T0  = mean_T0,
    sd_T0    = sd_T0,
    median_T0= med_T0,
    q1_T0    = q1_T0,
    q3_T0    = q3_T0,
    min_T0   = min(paired$T0),
    max_T0   = max(paired$T0),
    range_T0 = max(paired$T0) - min(paired$T0),
    mean_T12   = mean_T12,
    sd_T12     = sd_T12,
    median_T12 = med_T12,
    q1_T12     = q1_T12,
    q3_T12     = q3_T12,
    min_T12    = min(paired$T12),
    max_T12    = max(paired$T12),
    range_T12  = max(paired$T12) - min(paired$T12),
    diff_estimate = if (is_t) res_obj$mean_diff else res_obj$median_diff,
    ci_low        = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[1] else NA_real_,
    ci_high       = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[2] else NA_real_,
    effect_type   = res_obj$effect_size$type,
    effect_value  = res_obj$effect_size$value
  )
}

row_vitA <- .build_row_trans(df_vits, "VitaminA_ugdL", res_vitA)
row_vitD <- .build_row_trans(df_vits, "VitaminD_ngdL", res_vitD)
row_vitE <- .build_row_trans(df_vits, "VitaminE_ugdL", res_vitE)
```

```{r Export table, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  mutate(
    system   = str_trim(system),
    variable = str_trim(variable)
  )

# 2) Load the GLOBAL FDR table created in your "ONLY of interest" code
global_fdr_tbl <- read_csv(
  here("results", "clinical_globalFDR_pvalues.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    system   = str_trim(system),
    variable = str_trim(variable),
    p_fdr_global
  )

# 3) Keep ONLY rows that exist in the global list + join global FDR + reorder column
mega_tbl_final <- mega_tbl %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(global_fdr_tbl, by = c("system", "variable")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-tidyselect::any_of(c("p_fdr", "p_fdr_global"))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(global_fdr_tbl, by = c("system", "variable")) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(p_fdr_global, .after = p_value)

# 4) Export (Excel-friendly UTF-8 CSV)
write_excel_csv(mega_tbl_final, here("results", "clinical_results_mega_table_globalFDR_FINAL.csv"))
```

### Helper: compute per-patient baseline/followup/delt
```{r Helper deltas, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Helper to get deltas per patient
make_delta <- function(df, value_col, id = "PatientID", time = "Time") {
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(id, time, value_col))) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = dplyr::all_of(time),
      values_from = dplyr::all_of(value_col)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      baseline = T0,
      followup = T12,
      delta = T12 - T0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(id), baseline, followup, delta) %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(value_col, "_", .x), c(baseline, followup, delta))
}
```

### Build delta tables (each keeps only patients with T0+T12)
```{r Build data tables, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# BMI z-score
d_bmiz    <- make_delta(df_z,     "SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010")

# Quantity (eat more?)
d_kcal    <- make_delta(df_day,  "Ingestion_kcalday")

# Fat
d_fatg   <- make_delta(df_day,   "Fat_gday")

# Composition (eat fattier or not?)
d_fatdens <- make_delta(df_day,  "fat_g_1000kcal") # "fat density"
d_protdens <- make_delta(df_day,  "protein_g_1000kcal")
d_chdens <- make_delta(df_day,  "CH_g_1000kcal")
d_fibdens <- make_delta(df_day,  "fiber_g_1000kcal")
## Optional
d_calcdens <- make_delta(df_day, "Calcium_mg_1000kcal")
d_choldens <- make_delta(df_day, "Cholesterol_mg_1000kcal")

## Optional
d_fatpc   <- make_delta(df_day, "Perc_fat")
d_protpc  <- make_delta(df_day, "Perc_protein")
d_chpc    <- make_delta(df_day, "Perc_CH")

## Optional
d_calcium <- make_delta(df_day, "Calcium_mgday")
d_chol    <- make_delta(df_day, "Cholesterol_mgday")

# Body composition (does BMIz reflect fat vs lean vs water?)
d_fm      <- make_delta(df_bio,   "fat_mass_perc")
d_lm      <- make_delta(df_bio,   "lean_mass_perc")
d_tbw     <- make_delta(df_bio,   "total_body_water_perc")
d_fmi     <- make_delta(df_bio,   "fat_mass_index_kgm2")

# Markers (optional, but fine)
d_elas    <- make_delta(df_elas,  "Elastase")
d_calpro  <- make_delta(df_calpro,"Calprotectin")

# Absorption (only in 6/9)
d_cfa     <- make_delta(df_elas,  "CFA")
d_ffat    <- make_delta(df_elas,  "fecal_fat")

# Serum
d_schol <- make_delta(df_schol,  "serum_cholesterol_mgdL")
d_shdl  <- make_delta(df_schol,  "serum_HDL_mgdL")
d_sldl  <- make_delta(df_schol,  "serum_LDL_mgdL")
d_stri  <- make_delta(df_schol,  "serum_triglycerides_mgdL")
d_ldl_hdl_ratio <- make_delta(df_schol, "LDL_HDL_ratio")
d_non_hdl       <- make_delta(df_schol, "non_HDL_mgdL")

# Main delta table (n = 9)
delta_all <- d_bmiz %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_kcal,      by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_fatg,      by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_fatdens,   by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_protdens,  by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_chdens,    by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_fibdens,   by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_calcdens,  by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_choldens,  by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_fatpc,     by=  "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_protpc,    by=  "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_chpc,      by=  "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_calcium,   by=  "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_chol,      by=  "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_fm,        by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_lm,        by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_tbw,       by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_fmi,       by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_elas,      by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_calpro,    by = "PatientID")

# Absorption delta table (n = 6)
delta_abs <- delta_all %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_cfa,  by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_ffat, by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(CFA_delta, fecal_fat_delta))
```

Does the change in BMI z-score (ΔBMIz) relate to changes in other variables (Δkcal, Δfat, ΔTDEE, ΔCFA…)?
This is a “screening table” to identify which changes (diet, body composition, or biomarkers) are associated with changes in BMI z-score, after correction for multiple testing.
It compares changes with changes (Δ vs. Δ) in the main group (n ≈ 9):
ΔBMIz vs Δkcal
ΔBMIz vs Δfat
ΔBMIz vs ΔTDEE
… etc.

### Spearman correlations with FDR
Spearman “screening” (ΔBMIz vs lo demás) con FDR

#### ONLY FAT

```{r Spearman fat, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  "CH_g_1000kcal_delta"
)

res_cor_main <- purrr::map_dfr(vars_x_main, \(v) {
  tmp <- delta_all %>%
    dplyr::select(SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta, dplyr::all_of(v)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(.))
  if (nrow(tmp) < 6) return(tibble::tibble(var=v, n=nrow(tmp), rho=NA, p=NA))
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(tmp[[1]], tmp[[2]], method="spearman", exact=FALSE))
  tibble::tibble(var=v, n=nrow(tmp), rho=unname(ct$estimate), p=ct$p.value)
}) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method="fdr")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_fdr)

res_cor_main

readr::write_excel_csv(res_cor_main, here("results", "spearman_screening_BMIz_vs_fat_deltas_FDR.csv"))
```

#### Heatmap delta fat
```{r Heatmap Spearman fat, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
vars_heat <- c(
  "Ingestion_kcalday_delta",
  #"Fat_gday_delta",
  "fat_g_1000kcal_delta",
  "protein_g_1000kcal_delta",
  "CH_g_1000kcal_delta",
  "SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta"
)
dfh <- delta_all %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(vars_heat))

# Spearman rho matrix
rho_mat <- cor(dfh, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# P-value matrix using cor.test (pairwise), only if >= min_n pairs
min_n <- 6
p_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ncol(dfh), ncol = ncol(dfh),
                dimnames = list(colnames(dfh), colnames(dfh)))

for (r in seq_len(ncol(dfh))) {
  for (c in seq_len(ncol(dfh))) {
    x <- dfh[[r]]
    y <- dfh[[c]]
    ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
    if (sum(ok) >= min_n) {
      p_mat[r, c] <- suppressWarnings(
        cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value
      )
    }
  }
}

# Convert to long
idx <- setNames(seq_along(vars_heat), vars_heat)

rho_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(rho_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(var_row = Var1, var_col = Var2, rho = Freq)

p_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(p_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(var_row = Var1, var_col = Var2, p = Freq)

plot_df <- rho_long %>%
  dplyr::left_join(p_long, by = c("var_row", "var_col")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    i = idx[var_row],
    j = idx[var_col]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(i > j) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pair_id = paste0(pmin(i, j), "_", pmax(i, j))
  )

# GLOBAL FDR across all unique pairs shown in the heatmap
p_unique <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(pair_id, p) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"))

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(p_unique, by = "pair_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p_fdr) ~ "",
      p_fdr < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_fdr < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_fdr < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", rho), sig),
    var_col = factor(var_col, levels = vars_heat),
    var_row = factor(var_row, levels = rev(vars_heat))
  )

# Plot heatmap
p_heat_fat <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = var_col, y = var_row, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2C7BB6",
    mid = "grey95",
    high = "#D7191C",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Spearman ρ"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "Dietary change correlations (ΔT12–T0") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(file.path("results", "heatmap_spearman_deltas_FDR_macros_only.svg"),
       plot = p_heat_fat, device = "svg", width = 9, height = 7, units = "in")

### Heatmap results
tab_pairs_fat <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    var_row, var_col,
    rho,
    p_raw = p.x,      
    p_fdr
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::if_else(is.na(p_fdr), Inf, p_fdr))

readr::write_excel_csv(tab_pairs_fat, here("results", "heatmap_pairs_spearman_fat_deltas_allpairs_FDR.csv"))

tab_pairs_fat_sig <- tab_pairs_fat %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05)

readr::write_excel_csv(tab_pairs_fat_sig, here("results", "heatmap_pairs_spearman_fat_deltas_FDRsig.csv"))
```

```{r Serum lipids, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# BMIz delta vs each serum delta (EACH variable uses its own paired N)
# (Adds LDL/HDL ratio + non-HDL; keeps your "no complete-cases across all" logic)

delta_serum_any <- delta_all %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_schol,         by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_shdl,          by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_sldl,          by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_stri,          by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_ldl_hdl_ratio, by = "PatientID") %>%   
  dplyr::left_join(d_non_hdl,       by = "PatientID")
```

```{r Spearman serum chol, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta = T12 - T0,
    BMIz_dir = dplyr::case_when(
      SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta > 0 ~ "BMIz_up",
      SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta < 0 ~ "BMIz_down",
      TRUE ~ "BMIz_zero"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    PatientID,
    SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_baseline,
    SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_followup,
    SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta,
    BMIz_dir
  )

cat("\n=== CHECK N (BMIz paired) ===\n")
cat("n BMIz paired =", nrow(d_bmiz), "\n")
cat("n BMIz_up =", sum(d_bmiz$BMIz_dir == "BMIz_up"), "\n")
cat("n BMIz_down =", sum(d_bmiz$BMIz_dir == "BMIz_down"), "\n")
cat("n BMIz_zero =", sum(d_bmiz$BMIz_dir == "BMIz_zero"), "\n")

# 2) Build paired deltas (each variable keeps ONLY its own paired patients)
# 2.1) Energy intake (paired, typically n=9)
d_kcal <- df_day %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, Ingestion_kcalday) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = Ingestion_kcalday) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Ingestion_kcalday_baseline = T0,
    Ingestion_kcalday_followup = T12,
    Ingestion_kcalday_delta = T12 - T0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Ingestion_kcalday_baseline, Ingestion_kcalday_followup, Ingestion_kcalday_delta)

# 2.2) Serum markers (paired per marker)
d_schol <- df_schol %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, serum_cholesterol_mgdL) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = serum_cholesterol_mgdL) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    serum_cholesterol_mgdL_baseline = T0,
    serum_cholesterol_mgdL_followup = T12,
    serum_cholesterol_mgdL_delta = T12 - T0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, serum_cholesterol_mgdL_baseline, serum_cholesterol_mgdL_followup, serum_cholesterol_mgdL_delta)

d_shdl <- df_schol %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, serum_HDL_mgdL) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = serum_HDL_mgdL) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    serum_HDL_mgdL_baseline = T0,
    serum_HDL_mgdL_followup = T12,
    serum_HDL_mgdL_delta = T12 - T0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, serum_HDL_mgdL_baseline, serum_HDL_mgdL_followup, serum_HDL_mgdL_delta)

d_sldl <- df_schol %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, serum_LDL_mgdL) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = serum_LDL_mgdL) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    serum_LDL_mgdL_baseline = T0,
    serum_LDL_mgdL_followup = T12,
    serum_LDL_mgdL_delta = T12 - T0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, serum_LDL_mgdL_baseline, serum_LDL_mgdL_followup, serum_LDL_mgdL_delta)

d_stri <- df_schol %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, serum_triglycerides_mgdL) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = serum_triglycerides_mgdL) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    serum_triglycerides_mgdL_baseline = T0,
    serum_triglycerides_mgdL_followup = T12,
    serum_triglycerides_mgdL_delta = T12 - T0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, serum_triglycerides_mgdL_baseline, serum_triglycerides_mgdL_followup, serum_triglycerides_mgdL_delta)

# Ratios/non-HDL (paired per metric)
d_ldl_hdl_ratio <- df_schol %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, LDL_HDL_ratio) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = LDL_HDL_ratio) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    LDL_HDL_ratio_baseline = T0,
    LDL_HDL_ratio_followup = T12,
    LDL_HDL_ratio_delta = T12 - T0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, LDL_HDL_ratio_baseline, LDL_HDL_ratio_followup, LDL_HDL_ratio_delta)

d_non_hdl <- df_schol %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, non_HDL_mgdL) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = non_HDL_mgdL) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    non_HDL_mgdL_baseline = T0,
    non_HDL_mgdL_followup = T12,
    non_HDL_mgdL_delta = T12 - T0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, non_HDL_mgdL_baseline, non_HDL_mgdL_followup, non_HDL_mgdL_delta)

# 3) Merge into one "serum delta table" anchored on BMIz paired (keeps variable-specific N via NAs)
delta_serum <- d_bmiz %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_kcal,          by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_schol,         by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_shdl,          by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_sldl,          by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_stri,          by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_ldl_hdl_ratio, by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(d_non_hdl,       by = "PatientID")

cat("\n=== CHECK paired N per serum variable (within BMIz paired set) ===\n")
cat("HDL paired n =", sum(stats::complete.cases(delta_serum$serum_HDL_mgdL_baseline, delta_serum$serum_HDL_mgdL_followup)), "\n")
cat("LDL paired n =", sum(stats::complete.cases(delta_serum$serum_LDL_mgdL_baseline, delta_serum$serum_LDL_mgdL_followup)), "\n")
cat("LDL/HDL ratio paired n =", sum(stats::complete.cases(delta_serum$LDL_HDL_ratio_baseline, delta_serum$LDL_HDL_ratio_followup)), "\n")
cat("Total cholesterol paired n =", sum(stats::complete.cases(delta_serum$serum_cholesterol_mgdL_baseline, delta_serum$serum_cholesterol_mgdL_followup)), "\n")
cat("Triglycerides paired n =", sum(stats::complete.cases(delta_serum$serum_triglycerides_mgdL_baseline, delta_serum$serum_triglycerides_mgdL_followup)), "\n")
cat("non-HDL paired n =", sum(stats::complete.cases(delta_serum$non_HDL_mgdL_baseline, delta_serum$non_HDL_mgdL_followup)), "\n")
cat("kcal paired n =", sum(stats::complete.cases(delta_serum$Ingestion_kcalday_baseline, delta_serum$Ingestion_kcalday_followup)), "\n")

# 4) Direction tables (as in absorption) - signs only where the pair exists
dir_table_serum <- delta_serum %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    PatientID,
    BMIz_delta = SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta,
    BMIz_sign  = sign(SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta),

    HDL_sign   = ifelse(is.na(serum_HDL_mgdL_delta), NA, sign(serum_HDL_mgdL_delta)),
    LDL_sign   = ifelse(is.na(serum_LDL_mgdL_delta), NA, sign(serum_LDL_mgdL_delta)),
    Ratio_sign = ifelse(is.na(LDL_HDL_ratio_delta), NA, sign(LDL_HDL_ratio_delta)),
    nonHDL_sign= ifelse(is.na(non_HDL_mgdL_delta), NA, sign(non_HDL_mgdL_delta)),
    Chol_sign  = ifelse(is.na(serum_cholesterol_mgdL_delta), NA, sign(serum_cholesterol_mgdL_delta)),
    TG_sign    = ifelse(is.na(serum_triglycerides_mgdL_delta), NA, sign(serum_triglycerides_mgdL_delta))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(stringr::str_extract(PatientID, "\\d+") %>% as.numeric())

cat("\n=== Direction table (signs) ===\n")
print(dir_table_serum, n = Inf)

# Counts BMIz vs each serum sign (pairwise, like absorption)
cat("\nCount BMIz_sign vs HDL_sign (paired only):\n")
print(with(
  delta_serum %>% dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta, serum_HDL_mgdL_delta)),
  table(sign(SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta), sign(serum_HDL_mgdL_delta))
))

cat("\nCount BMIz_sign vs LDL_sign (paired only):\n")
print(with(
  delta_serum %>% dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta, serum_LDL_mgdL_delta)),
  table(sign(SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta), sign(serum_LDL_mgdL_delta))
))

cat("\nCount BMIz_sign vs LDL/HDL ratio sign (paired only):\n")
print(with(
  delta_serum %>% dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta, LDL_HDL_ratio_delta)),
  table(sign(SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta), sign(LDL_HDL_ratio_delta))
))

cat("\nCount BMIz_sign vs Total cholesterol sign (paired only):\n")
print(with(
  delta_serum %>% dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta, serum_cholesterol_mgdL_delta)),
  table(sign(SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta), sign(serum_cholesterol_mgdL_delta))
))

cat("\nCount BMIz_sign vs Triglycerides sign (paired only):\n")
print(with(
  delta_serum %>% dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta, serum_triglycerides_mgdL_delta)),
  table(sign(SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta), sign(serum_triglycerides_mgdL_delta))
))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) TRAJECTORIES (as in absorption), colored by BMIz_dir
#    Order requested: top row = HDL, LDL, LDL/HDL ratio ; bottom row = Total chol, TG
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

col_dir <- c("BMIz_up" = "#00BFC4", "BMIz_down" = "#F8766D", "BMIz_zero" = "grey60")

# Long: HDL
df_hdl_long <- delta_serum %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, BMIz_dir, serum_HDL_mgdL_baseline, serum_HDL_mgdL_followup) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(serum_HDL_mgdL_baseline, serum_HDL_mgdL_followup),
    names_to = "time", values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Time = dplyr::recode(time,
      "serum_HDL_mgdL_baseline" = "T0",
      "serum_HDL_mgdL_followup" = "T12"
    ),
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0", "T12")),
    marker = "HDL (mg/dL)"
  )

# Long: LDL
df_ldl_long <- delta_serum %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, BMIz_dir, serum_LDL_mgdL_baseline, serum_LDL_mgdL_followup) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(serum_LDL_mgdL_baseline, serum_LDL_mgdL_followup),
    names_to = "time", values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Time = dplyr::recode(time,
      "serum_LDL_mgdL_baseline" = "T0",
      "serum_LDL_mgdL_followup" = "T12"
    ),
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0", "T12")),
    marker = "LDL (mg/dL)"
  )

# Long: LDL/HDL ratio
df_ratio_long <- delta_serum %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, BMIz_dir, LDL_HDL_ratio_baseline, LDL_HDL_ratio_followup) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(LDL_HDL_ratio_baseline, LDL_HDL_ratio_followup),
    names_to = "time", values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Time = dplyr::recode(time,

    ),
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0", "T12")),

# Long: Total cholesterol
df_chol_long <- delta_serum %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, BMIz_dir, serum_cholesterol_mgdL_baseline, serum_cholesterol_mgdL_followup) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(serum_cholesterol_mgdL_baseline, serum_cholesterol_mgdL_followup),
    names_to = "time", values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Time = dplyr::recode(time,

    ),

# Long: Triglycerides
df_tg_long <- delta_serum %>%

df_traj_serum <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_hdl_long, df_ldl_long, df_ratio_long, df_chol_long, df_tg_long) %>%

p_traj_serum <- ggplot(df_traj_serum, aes(x = Time, y = value, group = PatientID, color = BMIz_dir)) +

p_traj_serum

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) HEATMAP Spearman + FDR ONLY BMIz_up (as in absorption)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# heatmap SOLO dentro de BMIz_up, y ahí sí aparece BMIz_delta con HDL/LDL/ratio pero solo en ese subgrupo (y con pares “pairwise” según disponibilidad).

delta_serum_up <- delta_serum %>%
  dplyr::filter(BMIz_dir == "BMIz_up")

cat("\n=== CHECK heatmap BMIz_up n ===\n")
cat("n BMIz_up =", nrow(delta_serum_up), "\n")

vars_heat_serum <- c(
  "serum_cholesterol_mgdL_delta",
  "serum_HDL_mgdL_delta",
  "serum_LDL_mgdL_delta",
  "LDL_HDL_ratio_delta",
  "serum_triglycerides_mgdL_delta",
  "non_HDL_mgdL_delta",
  "Ingestion_kcalday_delta",
  "SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta"
)

missing_vars <- setdiff(vars_heat_serum, names(delta_serum_up))
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) stop("Missing columns in delta_serum_up: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))

dfh <- delta_serum_up %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(vars_heat_serum))

# Spearman rho matrix (pairwise)
rho_mat <- cor(dfh, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# P-value matrix via cor.test (pairwise), only if >= min_n complete pairs
min_n <- 5
p_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ncol(dfh), ncol = ncol(dfh),
                dimnames = list(colnames(dfh), colnames(dfh)))

for (r in seq_len(ncol(dfh))) {
  for (c in seq_len(ncol(dfh))) {
    x <- dfh[[r]]
    y <- dfh[[c]]
    ok <- stats::complete.cases(x, y)
    if (sum(ok) >= min_n) {
      p_mat[r, c] <- suppressWarnings(
        stats::cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value
      )
    }
  }
}

# Long format (lower triangle only)
idx <- setNames(seq_along(vars_heat_serum), vars_heat_serum)

rho_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(rho_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(var_row = Var1, var_col = Var2, rho = Freq)

p_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(p_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(var_row = Var1, var_col = Var2, p_raw = Freq)

plot_df <- rho_long %>%
  dplyr::left_join(p_long, by = c("var_row", "var_col")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(i = idx[var_row], j = idx[var_col]) %>%
  dplyr::filter(i > j) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pair_id = paste0(pmin(i, j), "_", pmax(i, j)))

# Global FDR across shown pairs
p_unique <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(pair_id, p_raw) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_raw)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "fdr")) %>%
  dplyr::select(pair_id, p_fdr)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(p_unique, by = "pair_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p_fdr) ~ "",
      p_fdr < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_fdr < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_fdr < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", rho), sig),
    var_col = factor(var_col, levels = vars_heat_serum),
    var_row = factor(var_row, levels = rev(vars_heat_serum))
  )

p_heat_serum_up <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = var_col, y = var_row, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(width = 1, height = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2C7BB6",
    mid = "grey95",
    high = "#D7191C",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Spearman ρ"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(title = paste0("Serum-related correlations (ΔT12–T0), BMIz_up (n = ", nrow(delta_serum_up), ")"))

p_heat_serum_up

ggsave(
  here("results", "heatmap_spearman_delta_serum_only_BMIz_up_FDR.svg"),
  p_heat_serum_up, width = 9, height = 7, units = "in", bg = "white"
)

# Export pairs table (all + FDR-significant), as in absorption
tab_pairs_serum <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(var_row, var_col, rho, p_raw, p_fdr) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::if_else(is.na(p_fdr), Inf, p_fdr))

tab_pairs_serum_sig <- tab_pairs_serum %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05)

cat("\n=== Serum heatmap pairs (all) ===\n")
print(tab_pairs_serum, n = Inf)

cat("\n=== Serum heatmap pairs (FDR < 0.05) ===\n")
print(tab_pairs_serum_sig, n = Inf)

readr::write_csv(tab_pairs_serum,     here("results", "tab_pairs_delta_serum_only_BMIz_up_all.csv"))
readr::write_csv(tab_pairs_serum_sig, here("results", "tab_pairs_delta_serum_only_BMIz_up_FDRsig.csv"))
```

```{r Heatmap serum lipids, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =========================
# HEATMAP (pairwise N per cell; NO global complete-cases filtering)
# =========================

# --- pick the variables you want in the heatmap ---
vars_heat_serum <- c(
  "serum_cholesterol_mgdL_delta",
  "serum_HDL_mgdL_delta",

  "LDL_HDL_ratio_delta",

  LDL_HDL_ratio_delta                 = "Δ LDL/HDL ratio",
  serum_triglycerides_mgdL_delta      = "Δ Triglycerides (mg/dL)",
  non_HDL_mgdL_delta                  = "Δ Non-HDL (mg/dL)",
  Ingestion_kcalday_delta             = "Δ Ingestion (kcal/day)",
  SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta = "Δ BMIz"
)

# --- checks ---
missing_vars <- setdiff(vars_heat_serum, names(delta_serum_any))

dfh <- delta_serum_any %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(vars_heat_serum))

# --- Spearman rho matrix (PAIRWISE) ---
rho_mat <- stats::cor(dfh, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# --- N matrix (how many complete pairs per cell) ---
n_mat <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = ncol(dfh), ncol = ncol(dfh),
                dimnames = list(colnames(dfh), colnames(dfh)))
for (r in seq_len(ncol(dfh))) {
  for (c in seq_len(ncol(dfh))) {
    n_mat[r, c] <- sum(stats::complete.cases(dfh[[r]], dfh[[c]]))
  }
}

# --- P-value matrix (PAIRWISE; only if >= min_n pairs) ---
min_n <- 5
p_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ncol(dfh), ncol = ncol(dfh),
                dimnames = list(colnames(dfh), colnames(dfh)))

for (r in seq_len(ncol(dfh))) {
  for (c in seq_len(ncol(dfh))) {
    x <- dfh[[r]]
    y <- dfh[[c]]
    ok <- stats::complete.cases(x, y)
    if (sum(ok) >= min_n) {
      p_mat[r, c] <- suppressWarnings(
        stats::cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value
      )
    }
  }
}

# --- Long format (lower triangle only) ---
idx <- setNames(seq_along(vars_heat_serum), vars_heat_serum)

rho_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(rho_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(var_row = Var1, var_col = Var2, rho = Freq)

  dplyr::rename(var_row = Var1, var_col = Var2, p_raw = Freq)

n_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(n_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(var_row = Var1, var_col = Var2, n_pairs = Freq)

plot_df <- rho_long %>%
  dplyr::left_join(p_long, by = c("var_row", "var_col")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(n_long, by = c("var_row", "var_col")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(i = idx[var_row], j = idx[var_col]) %>%
  dplyr::filter(i > j) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pair_id = paste0(pmin(i, j), "_", pmax(i, j)))

# --- Global FDR across shown pairs ---
p_unique <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(pair_id, p_raw) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_raw)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_fdr = stats::p.adjust(p_raw, method = "fdr")) %>%
  dplyr::select(pair_id, p_fdr)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(p_unique, by = "pair_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p_fdr) ~ "",
      p_fdr < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_fdr < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_fdr < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    var_col_lab = dplyr::recode(var_col, !!!var_labels),
    var_row_lab = dplyr::recode(var_row, !!!var_labels),
    var_col_lab = factor(var_col_lab, levels = var_labels[vars_heat_serum]),
    var_row_lab = factor(var_row_lab, levels = rev(var_labels[vars_heat_serum])),
    label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", rho), sig, "\n(n=", n_pairs, ")")
  )

p_heat_serum_pairwise <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_df, ggplot2::aes(x = var_col_lab, y = var_row_lab, fill = rho)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(width = 1, height = 1) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = label), size = 3) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2C7BB6",
    mid = "grey95",
    high = "#D7191C",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Spearman ρ"
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_fixed() +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Pairwise Spearman correlations (ΔT12–T0)")
```

## 0.1. Function: run LMM z(outcome) ~ z(taxon) + Time + (1|PatientID) or z(outcome) ~ z(taxon) + Time + PatientID if singular fit
```{r Function LMM, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
run_lmm_taxa_vs_outcomes <- function(dat_long,
                                    taxa_keep,
                                    outcomes,
                                    taxon_col = "taxon_val",
                                    id_col = "PatientID",
                                    time_col = "Time",
                                    tol_singular = 1e-4) {

  # safety check
  missing_out <- setdiff(outcomes, colnames(dat_long))
  if (length(missing_out) > 0) {
    stop("These outcomes are missing in dat_long: ", paste(missing_out, collapse = ", "))
  }

  purrr::map_dfr(outcomes, function(out) {

    out <- as.character(out)[1]

    purrr::map_dfr(taxa_keep, function(tx) {

      tx <- as.character(tx)[1]

      dat_tx <- dat_long %>%
        dplyr::filter(FeatureID == tx) %>%
        dplyr::select(FeatureID, dplyr::all_of(c(taxon_col, out, time_col, id_col))) %>%
        dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(.)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          !!time_col := factor(.data[[time_col]], levels = c("T0","T12")),
          !!id_col   := factor(.data[[id_col]])
        )

      # skip if too few points or no variance
      if (nrow(dat_tx) < 6 ||
          sd(dat_tx[[taxon_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0 ||
          sd(dat_tx[[out]],       na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
        return(tibble::tibble(
          Outcome = out, FeatureID = tx, n = nrow(dat_tx),
          beta_SD = NA_real_, conf.low = NA_real_, conf.high = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
          singular_fit = NA, model_used = NA_character_
        ))
      }

      # standardize within this model dataset
      dat_tx <- dat_tx %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          taxon_z = as.numeric(scale(.data[[taxon_col]])),
          y_z     = as.numeric(scale(.data[[out]]))
        )

      # 1) Fit LMM first
      fml_lmm <- stats::as.formula(paste0("y_z ~ taxon_z + ", time_col, " + (1|", id_col, ")"))
      fit_lmm <- lmerTest::lmer(fml_lmm, data = dat_tx)

      sing <- lme4::isSingular(fit_lmm, tol = tol_singular)

      # 2) If singular, refit with PatientID as fixed effect
      if (isTRUE(sing)) {

        fml_fe <- stats::as.formula(paste0("y_z ~ taxon_z + ", time_col, " + ", id_col))
        fit_fe <- stats::lm(fml_fe, data = dat_tx)

        co <- summary(fit_fe)$coefficients
        ci <- suppressWarnings(stats::confint(fit_fe, parm = "taxon_z"))

        return(tibble::tibble(
          Outcome   = out,
          FeatureID = tx,
          n         = nrow(dat_tx),
          beta_SD   = unname(co["taxon_z","Estimate"]),
          conf.low  = ci[1],
          conf.high = ci[2],
          p         = unname(co["taxon_z","Pr(>|t|)"]),
          singular_fit = TRUE,
          model_used   = "FE_PatientID"
        ))
      }

      # 3) Otherwise keep LMM results
      co <- summary(fit_lmm)$coefficients
      ci <- suppressWarnings(confint(fit_lmm, parm = "taxon_z", method = "Wald"))

      tibble::tibble(
        Outcome   = out,
        FeatureID = tx,
        n         = nrow(dat_tx),
        beta_SD   = unname(co["taxon_z","Estimate"]),
        conf.low  = ci[1],
        conf.high = ci[2],
        p         = unname(co["taxon_z","Pr(>|t|)"]),
        singular_fit = FALSE,
        model_used   = "LMM"
      )
    })

  }) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Outcome) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p_fdr_outcome = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p_fdr_global = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))
}
```

## 0.2. Helper: build forest dataframe for a given group
```{r Helper forest, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
prep_forest_df <- function(res_table, outcomes_vec, labels_vec, taxa_order) {

  res_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(Outcome %in% outcomes_vec, FeatureID %in% taxa_order) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Outcome_label = dplyr::recode(Outcome, !!!as.list(labels_vec)),
      Outcome_label = factor(Outcome_label,
                             levels = rev(unname(labels_vec[outcomes_vec]))),
      FeatureID = factor(FeatureID, levels = taxa_order),
      sig = !is.na(.data[[FDR_COL]]) & .data[[FDR_COL]] < 0.05
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(beta_SD), !is.na(conf.low), !is.na(conf.high))
}
```

## 0.3. Taxa deltas for microbiota
```{r Taxa deltas, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load the long RA table
ra <- read_delim(here("data", "RA_plot_relabundance_long.csv"))
colnames(ra)

# Standardize + keep only the 3 taxa
taxa_keep <- c("Adlercreutzia_equolifaciens", "Clostridium_SGB6179", "Flavonifractor_plautii")

ra2 <- ra %>%
  mutate(
    PatientID = sub("H\\d+$", "", SampleID),
    Time = case_when(
      Time %in% c("T0","time0","Time0") ~ "T0",
      Time %in% c("T12","time12","Time12") ~ "T12",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Time)
    ),
    RelAbundance = as.numeric(RelAbundance)
  ) %>%
  filter(FeatureID %in% taxa_keep)

# Build Δ per taxon (log1p handles zeros nicely)
taxa_delta <- ra2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(val = log1p(RelAbundance)) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, FeatureID, Time, val) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = val) %>%
  dplyr::filter(complete.cases(T0, T12)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(delta = T12 - T0) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, FeatureID, delta) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = FeatureID,
    values_from = delta,
    names_glue = "{FeatureID}_delta"
  )

# Join to your existing delta table (delta_all)
delta_all_taxa <- delta_all %>%
  left_join(taxa_delta, by = "PatientID")

colnames(taxa_delta)
summary(delta_all_taxa[, grep("_delta$", colnames(delta_all_taxa))])
```

# 1. Microbiome composition and BMIz
## Spearman
```{r Microbiota composition and BMIz, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
taxa_y <- c(
  "Adlercreutzia_equolifaciens_delta",
  "Clostridium_SGB6179_delta",
  "Flavonifractor_plautii_delta"
)

vars_x <- c("SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta")

min_n <- 6

res_spear_taxa_bmiz <- purrr::map_dfr(taxa_y, \(ty) {
  purrr::map_dfr(vars_x, \(vx) {

    tmp <- delta_all_taxa %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(ty, vx))) %>%
      dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(.))

    if (nrow(tmp) < min_n) {
      return(tibble::tibble(taxon = ty, var = vx, n = nrow(tmp), rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
    }

    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(tmp[[1]], tmp[[2]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
    tibble::tibble(taxon = ty, var = vx, n = nrow(tmp), rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value)
  })
}) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_fdr)

res_spear_taxa_bmiz
write.csv(res_spear_taxa_bmiz, "res_spearman_taxa_BMIz.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### Heatmap
```{r Heatmap, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
vars_heat <- c(
  "Adlercreutzia_equolifaciens_delta",
  "Clostridium_SGB6179_delta",
  "Flavonifractor_plautii_delta",
  "SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010_delta"
)

dfh <- delta_all_taxa %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(vars_heat))

# Spearman rho matrix
rho_mat <- cor(dfh, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# P-value matrix (pairwise cor.test), only if >= min_n pairs
min_n <- 6
p_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ncol(dfh), ncol = ncol(dfh),
                dimnames = list(colnames(dfh), colnames(dfh)))

for (r in seq_len(ncol(dfh))) {
  for (c in seq_len(ncol(dfh))) {
    x <- dfh[[r]]
    y <- dfh[[c]]
    ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
    if (sum(ok) >= min_n) {
      p_mat[r, c] <- suppressWarnings(
        cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value
      )
    }
  }
}

# Convert to long format
idx <- setNames(seq_along(vars_heat), vars_heat)

rho_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(rho_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(var_row = Var1, var_col = Var2, rho = Freq)

p_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(p_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(var_row = Var1, var_col = Var2, p = Freq)

plot_df <- rho_long %>%
  dplyr::left_join(p_long, by = c("var_row", "var_col")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    i = idx[var_row],
    j = idx[var_col]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(i > j) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pair_id = paste0(pmin(i, j), "_", pmax(i, j)))

# GLOBAL FDR across all unique pairs shown in the heatmap
p_unique <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(pair_id, p) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"))

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(p_unique, by = "pair_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p_fdr) ~ "",
      p_fdr < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_fdr < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_fdr < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", rho), sig),
    var_col = factor(var_col, levels = vars_heat),
    var_row = factor(var_row, levels = rev(vars_heat))
  )

# Plot heatmap
p_heat_taxa_bmiz <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = var_col, y = var_row, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2C7BB6",
    mid = "grey95",
    high = "#D7191C",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Spearman ρ"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "Spearman correlations of changes (ΔT12–T0): taxa vs BMIz") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_heat_taxa_bmiz

# --- Save as SVG ---
ggsave("heatmap_spearman_deltas_FDR_taxa_bmiz.svg",
       plot = p_heat_taxa_bmiz, device = "svg", width = 11, height = 9, units = "in")
```

## LMER
```{r LMER, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
taxa_keep <- c("Adlercreutzia_equolifaciens", "Clostridium_SGB6179", "Flavonifractor_plautii")

# Long microbiome table
dat_long <- ra2 %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, FeatureID, RelAbundance) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(taxon_val = log1p(RelAbundance)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    df_z %>%
      dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010),
    by = c("PatientID", "Time")
  )

dat_long2 <- dat_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0","T12")),
    PatientID = factor(PatientID)
  )

res_lmer_taxa_BMIz_SD <- purrr::map_dfr(taxa_keep, \(tx) {

  dat_tx <- dat_long2 %>%
    filter(FeatureID == tx) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(taxon_val, SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010, Time))

  if (nrow(dat_tx) < 6 ||
      sd(dat_tx$taxon_val, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 ||
      sd(dat_tx$SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      FeatureID = tx,
      n = nrow(dat_tx),
      beta_SD = NA_real_, conf.low = NA_real_, conf.high = NA_real_, p = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  dat_tx <- dat_tx %>%
    mutate(
      taxon_z = as.numeric(scale(taxon_val)),
      bmi_z   = as.numeric(scale(SD_z_score_BMI_Carrascosa2010))
    )

  fit <- lmer(bmi_z ~ taxon_z + Time + (1|PatientID), data = dat_tx)
  co  <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  ci  <- suppressWarnings(confint(fit, parm = "taxon_z", method = "Wald"))

  tibble(
    FeatureID = tx,
    n = nrow(dat_tx),
    beta_SD = co["taxon_z","Estimate"],
    conf.low = ci[1],
    conf.high = ci[2],
    p = co["taxon_z","Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"),
    sig = !is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05
  )

res_lmer_taxa_BMIz_SD
write.csv(res_lmer_taxa_BMIz_SD, "res_lmer_taxa_BMIz_SD.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r Heatmap, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  dplyr::filter(i > j) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pair_id = paste0(pmin(i, j), "_", pmax(i, j)))

# GLOBAL FDR across all unique pairs shown in the heatmap
p_unique <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(pair_id, p) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"))

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(p_unique, by = "pair_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p_fdr) ~ "",
      p_fdr < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_fdr < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_fdr < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", rho), sig),
    var_col = factor(var_col, levels = vars_heat),
    var_row = factor(var_row, levels = rev(vars_heat))
  )

# Plot heatmap
p_heat_taxa_diet_dens <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = var_col, y = var_row, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2C7BB6",
    mid = "grey95",
    high = "#D7191C",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Spearman ρ"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "Spearman correlations of changes (ΔT12–T0): taxa vs diet") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_heat_taxa_diet_dens

# Save as SVG
ggsave("heatmap_spearman_deltas_FDR_taxa_diet_only_densities.svg",
       plot = p_heat_taxa_diet_dens, device = "svg", width = 11, height = 9, units = "in")
```

```{r LMER, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
taxa_keep <- c("Adlercreutzia_equolifaciens", "Clostridium_SGB6179", "Flavonifractor_plautii")

diet_outcomes <- c(
  "Ingestion_kcalday",
  "fat_g_1000kcal",
  "protein_g_1000kcal",
  "CH_g_1000kcal",
  "fiber_g_1000kcal",
  "Calcium_mg_1000kcal",
  "Cholesterol_mg_1000kcal"
)

# Harmonize Time to "T0"/"T12"
fix_time <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("T0","0","Time0","time0","baseline") ~ "T0",
    x %in% c("T12","12","Time12","time12","followup") ~ "T12",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

# ONE row per PatientID-Time for diet
meta_diet <- df_day %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Time = fix_time(Time)) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, dplyr::all_of(diet_outcomes)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(PatientID, Time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(diet_outcomes), ~ if (all(is.na(.x))) NA_real_ else mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
    )

# Microbiome long table

  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, FeatureID, RelAbundance) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    taxon_val = log1p(RelAbundance)
  )

# Join diet into microbiome long table (dat_long)
dat_long_diet_full <- dat_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Time = fix_time(Time),
    PatientID = as.character(PatientID)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta_diet, by = c("PatientID","Time")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0","T12")),
    PatientID = factor(PatientID)
  )

# Run LMM with FE fallback if singular
res_lmm_diet_dens <- run_lmm_taxa_vs_outcomes(
  dat_long = dat_long_diet_full,
  taxa_keep = taxa_keep,
  outcomes = diet_outcomes
)
```

# 3. Microbiome composition vs body composition
## Spearman
```{r Microbiota composition and body composition, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
taxa_y <- c(
  "Adlercreutzia_equolifaciens_delta",
  "Clostridium_SGB6179_delta",
  "Flavonifractor_plautii_delta"
)

vars_x <- c(
  "fat_mass_perc_delta",
  "fat_mass_index_kgm2_delta",
  "lean_mass_perc_delta",
  "total_body_water_perc_delta"
)

min_n <- 6

res_spear_taxa_bio <- purrr::map_dfr(taxa_y, \(ty) {
  purrr::map_dfr(vars_x, \(vx) {
    tmp <- delta_all_taxa %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(ty, vx))) %>%
      dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(.))

    if (nrow(tmp) < min_n) {
      return(tibble::tibble(taxon = ty, var = vx, n = nrow(tmp), rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
    }

    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(tmp[[1]], tmp[[2]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
    tibble::tibble(taxon = ty, var = vx, n = nrow(tmp), rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value)
  })
}) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_fdr)

res_spear_taxa_bio

write.csv(res_spear_taxa_bio, "res_spearman_taxa_bio.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### Heatmap
```{r Heatmap, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
vars_heat <- c(
  "Adlercreutzia_equolifaciens_delta",
  "Clostridium_SGB6179_delta",
  "Flavonifractor_plautii_delta",
  "fat_mass_perc_delta",
  "fat_mass_index_kgm2_delta",
  "lean_mass_perc_delta",
  "total_body_water_perc_delta"
)

dfh <- delta_all_taxa %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(vars_heat))

# Spearman rho matrix
rho_mat <- cor(dfh, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# P-value matrix (pairwise cor.test), only if >= min_n pairs
min_n <- 6
p_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ncol(dfh), ncol = ncol(dfh),
                dimnames = list(colnames(dfh), colnames(dfh)))

for (r in seq_len(ncol(dfh))) {
  for (c in seq_len(ncol(dfh))) {
    x <- dfh[[r]]
    y <- dfh[[c]]
    ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
    if (sum(ok) >= min_n) {
      p_mat[r, c] <- suppressWarnings(
        cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value
      )
    }
  }
}

# Convert to long format
idx <- setNames(seq_along(vars_heat), vars_heat)

rho_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(rho_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(var_row = Var1, var_col = Var2, rho = Freq)

p_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(p_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(var_row = Var1, var_col = Var2, p = Freq)

plot_df <- rho_long %>%
  dplyr::left_join(p_long, by = c("var_row", "var_col")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    i = idx[var_row],
    j = idx[var_col]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(i > j) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pair_id = paste0(pmin(i, j), "_", pmax(i, j)))

# GLOBAL FDR across all unique pairs shown in the heatmap
p_unique <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(pair_id, p) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"))

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(p_unique, by = "pair_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p_fdr) ~ "",
      p_fdr < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_fdr < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_fdr < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", rho), sig),
    var_col = factor(var_col, levels = vars_heat),
    var_row = factor(var_row, levels = rev(vars_heat))
  )

# Plot heatmap
p_heat_taxa_bio <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = var_col, y = var_row, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2C7BB6",
    mid = "grey95",
    high = "#D7191C",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Spearman ρ"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "Spearman correlations of changes (ΔT12–T0): taxa vs bio") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_heat_taxa_bio

# --- Save as SVG ---
ggsave("heatmap_spearman_deltas_FDR_taxa_bio.svg",
       plot = p_heat_taxa_bio, device = "svg", width = 11, height = 9, units = "in")
```

```{r LMER, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("T0","0","Time0","time0","baseline") ~ "T0",
    x %in% c("T12","12","Time12","time12","followup") ~ "T12",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

# ONE row per PatientID-Time for diet
meta_schol <- df_schol %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Time = fix_time(Time)) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, dplyr::all_of(schol_outcomes)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(PatientID, Time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(schol_outcomes), ~ if (all(is.na(.x))) NA_real_ else mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
    )

# Microbiome long table
dat_long <- ra2 %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, FeatureID, RelAbundance) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    taxon_val = log1p(RelAbundance)
  )

# Join diet into microbiome long table (dat_long)
dat_long_schol_full <- dat_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Time = fix_time(Time),
    PatientID = as.character(PatientID)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta_schol, by = c("PatientID","Time")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0","T12")),
    PatientID = factor(PatientID)
  )

# Run LMM with FE fallback if singular
res_lmm_schol <- run_lmm_taxa_vs_outcomes(
  dat_long = dat_long_schol_full,
  taxa_keep = taxa_keep,
  outcomes = schol_outcomes
)

res_lmm_schol
write.csv(res_lmm_schol, "res_lmm_taxa_vs_schol_LMM_SD.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## LMER FOR PAIRED MEASURES PER OUTCOME (n = 16 and n = 14)
### LMER
```{r LMER, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
taxa_keep <- c("Adlercreutzia_equolifaciens", "Clostridium_SGB6179", "Flavonifractor_plautii")

schol_outcomes <- c(
  "serum_cholesterol_mgdL",
  "serum_HDL_mgdL",
  "serum_LDL_mgdL",
  "LDL_HDL_ratio",
  "serum_triglycerides_mgdL",
  "non_HDL_mgdL"
)

# Harmonize Time to "T0"/"T12"
fix_time <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("T0","0","Time0","time0","baseline") ~ "T0",
    x %in% c("T12","12","Time12","time12","followup") ~ "T12",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

# ONE row per PatientID-Time for serum lipids
meta_schol <- df_schol %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Time = fix_time(Time)) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, dplyr::all_of(schol_outcomes)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(PatientID, Time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(schol_outcomes),
                  ~ if (all(is.na(.x))) NA_real_ else mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Microbiome long table
dat_long <- ra2 %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, FeatureID, RelAbundance) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    taxon_val = log1p(RelAbundance)
  )

# Join serum lipids into microbiome long table (dat_long)
dat_long_schol_full <- dat_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Time = fix_time(Time),
    PatientID = as.character(PatientID)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta_schol, by = c("PatientID","Time")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0","T12")),
    PatientID = factor(PatientID)
  )

# Helper: keep only patients with BOTH T0 and T12 available for a given outcome
keep_paired_ids_for_outcome <- function(dat, outcome_col) {
  ids <- dat %>%
    dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, value = !!rlang::sym(outcome_col)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(PatientID) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      has_T0  = any(Time == "T0"  & !is.na(value)),
      has_T12 = any(Time == "T12" & !is.na(value)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_T0 & has_T12) %>%
    dplyr::pull(PatientID)
  ids
}

# Run paired-only LMM per outcome, then bind results
res_lmm_schol_pairs <- purrr::map_dfr(schol_outcomes, function(out) {
  paired_ids <- keep_paired_ids_for_outcome(dat_long_schol_full, out)

  dat_pairs <- dat_long_schol_full %>%
    dplyr::filter(PatientID %in% paired_ids)
  
  dat_pairs <- droplevels(dat_pairs)

  # Run LMM for THIS outcome only (with FE fallback if singular)
  run_lmm_taxa_vs_outcomes(
    dat_long  = dat_pairs,
    taxa_keep = taxa_keep,
    outcomes  = out
  )
})

# Recompute FDR columns consistently AFTER combining outcomes
res_lmm_schol_pairs <- res_lmm_schol_pairs %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Outcome) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_fdr_outcome = stats::p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_fdr_global = stats::p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
    sig = p_fdr_global < 0.05
  )

res_lmm_schol_pairs
write.csv(res_lmm_schol_pairs, "res_lmm_taxa_vs_schol_LMM_SD_pairs.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
